chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Physiology | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.0 Introduction
chapterContent:
Izitshalo zibalulekile ekuphileni kwabantu njengomhlaba, amanzi, nomoya. Ngaphandle kwezitshalo, izimpilo zethu zansuku zonke bezingenakwenzeka ngoba ngaphandle komoya-mpilo ovela ku-photosynthesis, impilo ye-aerobic ayinakuqhubeka. Kusukela ekuhlinzekeni ukudla nendawo yokukhosela kuya ekusebenzeni njengomthombo wemithi, amafutha, amakha, kanye nemikhiqizo yezimboni, izitshalo zinikeza abantu izinsiza eziningi ezibalulekile.

 Uma ucabanga ngezitshalo, lezo ezifika kuqala engqondweni cishe ziyizitshalo zemithambo yegazi. Lezi zitshalo zinezicubu eziqhuba ukudla namanzi (igama elithi vascular `lisho ukuba nemithambo yegazi`). Ngenkathi uhlobo ngalunye lwesitshalo semithambo yegazi luhlukile, zonke zakhiwe umzimba wesitshalo oqukethe iziqu, izimpande, namaqabunga. Zonke zithutha amanzi, amaminerali, noshukela okhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis emzimbeni wesitshalo kusetshenziswa indlela efanayo, futhi zonke zisabela ezicini zemvelo, njengokukhanya, amandla adonsela phansi, ukuncintisana, izinga lokushisa, kanye nokudla. Ososayensi basanda kuthola ukuthi izitshalo ezimbili, i-giant goldenrod kanye ne-spicebush, ngayinye yenza ama-com amahlanu ahlukene amakhilogremu aphazamisa imijikelezo yokuphila kwezinambuzane ezinambuzane. Uphenyo olwengeziwe ngamakhemikhali lungaholela ekilasini elisha lezibulala-zinambuzane. Bheka Umfanekiso 23.1
question1: Kungani izitshalo zibalulekile ekuphileni kwabantu?
answer1: Zikhiqiza umoya-mpilo nge-photosynthesis futhi zihlinzeka ngokudla, indawo yokuhlala, imithi, amafutha, amakha, kanye nemikhiqizo yezimboni
question2: Yiluphi uhlobo lwezitshalo okukhulunywa ngalo kakhulu kulesi singeniso?
question3: Lisho ukuthini igama elithi imithambo yegazi ezitshalweni?
question4: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezakha umzimba wesitshalo semithambo yegazi?
answer4: Iziqu, izimpande, namaqabunga
question5: Yiziphi izinto ezithuthwa yizitshalo ezinemithambo yegazi emizimbeni yazo?
answer5: Amanzi, amaminerali, noshukela okukhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis
question6: Yiziphi izici zemvelo ezisabela kuzo izitshalo zemithambo yegazi?
answer6: Ukukhanya, amandla adonsela phansi, ukuncintisana, izinga lokushisa, kanye nokudla izilwane
question7: Kungani ososayensi befunda nge-com amakhilogremu ekhiqizwa yi-giant goldenrod kanye ne-spicebush?
answer7: Zingaholela ekilasini elisha lezibulala-zinambuzane ngokuphazamisa imijikelezo yokuphila kwezinambuzane eziyingozi

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.1 Umzimba Wezitshalo | Ukuxhumana Nezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.1 The Plant Body | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Okuningi okuqukethwe kulesi sahluko akukho ngaphakathi kwe-AP®, kufaka phakathi ulwazi mayelana nezinhlobo ezahlukene zezicubu ezakha umzimba wesitshalo. Kodwa-ke, ukuvela kwezicubu zemithambo kwenza kwaba nokwenzeka ukuguquka kwezitshalo kusuka ezindaweni zasemanzini kuya ezindaweni zomhlaba. I-Xylem ne-phloem zithutha amanzi, amaminerali, noshukela okukhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis emzimbeni wesitshalo (bheka i-Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants module). Ngaphezu kwalokho zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo zisabela ezicini zemvelo, njengokukhanya, amandla adonsela phansi, ukuncintisana, izinga lokushisa, kanye nokudla (bheka i-Plant Sensory Systems and Reponses module). Njengezilwane, izitshalo ziqukethe amaseli ane-organelles, lapho kwenzeka khona imisebenzi ethile ye-metabolic, kanye nezicubu nezitho ezikhethekile. Ngokungafani nezilwane, izitshalo zisebenzisa amandla avela elangeni ukuze zenze ushukela ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis—zidala ukudla okusekela ukuphila kule planethi. Ngaphandle kwezitshalo, ukuphila eMhlabeni bekungeke kube khona.

 Ngaphandle kwezicubu zemithambo yegazi—esizozihlola ngokuningiliziwe ku-Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants module—ulwazi oluvezwe kulesi sigaba, kanye nezibonelo ezigqanyisiwe, aluhambisani nokuqukethwe kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ze-AP® ezichazwe ku-AP® Curriculum Framework.

 Imibuzo Yenselele Yokuzijwayeza Isayensi iqukethe imibuzo eyengeziwe yokuhlola yalesi sigaba ezokusiza ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwe-AP. Le mibuzo ibhekana namazinga alandelayo:
[APLO 2.3][APLO 2.4][APLO 2.28][APLO 4.15][APLO 4.14][APLO 4.21]

 Njenge-eukaryotes, izitshalo ziqukethe amaseli anama-organelle lapho kwenzeka khona imisebenzi ethile ye-metabolic. Nokho, ngokungafani nezilwane, izitshalo zisebenzisa amandla avela elangeni ukuze zenze ushukela ngesikhathi se-photosynthesis. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaseli ezitshalo anezindonga zamaseli, ama-plastid, kanye ne-vacuole enkulu ephakathi: izakhiwo ezingatholakali kumaseli ezilwane. Isakhiwo ngasinye samaseli sidlala indima ethile esakhiweni nasemsebenzini wesitshalo.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.1 Umzimba Wezitshalo | Izinhlelo Zezitho Zezitshalo
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.1 The Plant Body | Plant Organ Systems
chapterContent: Ezitshalweni, njengasezilwaneni, amangqamuzana afanayo asebenza ndawonye akha izicubu. Lapho izinhlobo ezahlukene zezicubu zisebenza ndawonye ukuze zenze umsebenzi oyingqayizivele, zakha isitho; izitho ezisebenza ndawonye zakha izinhlelo zezitho. Izitshalo zemithambo yegazi zinezinhlelo ezimbili zezitho ezihlukile: uhlelo lokudubula, kanye nohlelo lwezimpande. Uhlelo lokudubula luqukethe izingxenye ezimbili: izingxenye zezitshalo (ezingazali) zesitshalo, njengamaqabunga neziqu, kanye nezingxenye zokuzala zesitshalo, ezihlanganisa izimbali nezithelo. Uhlelo lokudubula ngokuvamile lukhula ngaphezu komhlabathi, lapho lumunca khona ukukhanya okudingekayo kwi-photosynthesis. Uhlelo lwezimpande, olusekela izitshalo futhi lumunce amanzi namaminerali, luvame ukuba ngaphansi komhlaba. Isithombe 23.2 sibonisa izinhlelo zezitho zesitshalo esivamile
question1: Yini eyakha izicubu ezitshalweni?
distractor1b: Izinhlelo eziningana zezitho zomzimba ezisebenza ndawonye
question2: Yini eyakheka lapho izinhlobo ezahlukene zezicubu zisebenza ndawonye ukuze zenze umsebenzi oyingqayizivele?
question3: Zingaki izinhlelo zezitho ezitshalweni zemithambo yegazi?
answer3: Okwesibili: uhlelo lokudubula kanye nohlelo lwezimpande
distractor3b: Okuthathu: izinhlelo zokudubula, impande, kanye nemithambo yegazi
question4: Yiziphi izakhiwo eziyingxenye yengxenye yezitshalo zesistimu yokudubula?
answer4: Amaqabunga neziqu
question5: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezakha ingxenye yokuzala yesistimu yokudubula?
answer5: Izimbali nezithelo
question6: Kungani uhlelo lokudubula luvame ukukhula ngaphezu komhlabathi?
answer6: Ukuze kutholakale ukukhanya okudingekayo ukuze kusetshenziswe i-photosynthesis
question7: Yimiphi imisebenzi eyinhloko yesistimu yezimpande?
answer7: Ukusekela isitshalo nokumunca amanzi namaminerali

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nokusebenza Kwaso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.1 Umzimba Wesitshalo | Izicubu Zezitshalo
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.1 The Plant Body | Plant Tissues
chapterContent:
Izitshalo ziyi-eukaryotes ezinamaseli amaningi enezinhlelo zezicubu ezenziwe ngezinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli ezenza imisebenzi ethile. Izinhlelo zezicubu zezitshalo ziwela kolunye lwezinhlobo ezimbili ezijwayelekile: izicubu ze-meristematic, kanye nezicubu ezihlala njalo (noma ezingezona eze-meristematic). Amaseli ezicubu ze-meristematic atholakala kuma-meristems, okuyizindawo zezitshalo zokuhlukaniswa nokukhula okuqhubekayo kwamaseli. Amaseli ezicubu ze-meristematic awahlukanisiwe noma awahlukanisiwe ngokuphelele, futhi ayaqhubeka nokuhlukana futhi anikele ekukhuleni kwesitshalo. Ngokuphambene nalokho, izicubu ezihlala njalo zakhiwa amaseli ezitshalo angasahlukani ngokusebenzayo.

 Izicubu ze-meristematic zakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezintathu, ngokusekelwe endaweni yazo esitshalweni. Ama-meristems e-apical aqukethe izicubu ze-meristematic ezitholakala eziqongweni zeziqu nezimpande, okuvumela isitshalo ukuthi sikhule ngobude. Ama-meristems aseceleni enza kube lula ukukhula ngobukhulu noma ububanzi esitshalweni esivuthiwe. Ama-meristems aphakathi kwekhala atholakala kuphela kuma-monocots, ezisekelweni zama-blade amaqabunga kanye nasezindaweni lapho amaqabunga enamathela khona esiqwini. Lesi zicubu senza i-blade yeqabunga le-monocot ikhule ngobude kusukela esisekelweni seqabunga; isibonelo, ivumela amaqabunga otshani botshani ukuthi ande ngisho nangemva kokugawulwa okuphindaphindiwe.

 Ama-Meristems akhiqiza amangqamuzana ahlukanisa ngokushesha, noma akhethekile, futhi abe izicubu ezihlala njalo. Amangqamuzana anjalo athatha izindima ezithile futhi alahlekelwe ikhono lawo lokuhlukana ngokwengeziwe. Ahlukana ngezinhlobo ezintathu eziyinhloko: izicubu zesikhumba, izicubu zemithambo yegazi, kanye nezicubu ezigayiwe. Izicubu zesikhumba zimboza futhi zivikele isitshalo, kanti izicubu zemithambo yegazi zithutha amanzi, amaminerali, noshukela ziye ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesitshalo. Izicubu ezigayiwe zisebenza njengendawo ye-photosynthesis, zinikeza i-matrix esekelayo yezicubu zemithambo yegazi, futhi zisiza ukugcina amanzi noshukela.

 Izicubu zesibili zilula (zakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezifanayo zamaseli) noma ziyinkimbinkimbi (zakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli). Izicubu zesikhumba, isibonelo, izicubu ezilula ezimboza ubuso bangaphandle besitshalo futhi zilawula ukushintshaniswa kwegesi. Izicubu zemithambo yegazi ziyisibonelo sezicubu eziyinkimbinkimbi, futhi zenziwe ngezicubu ezimbili ezikhethekile zokuqhuba: i-xylem ne-phloem. Izicubu ze-Xylem zithutha amanzi nezakhamzimba kusuka ezimpandeni kuya ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesitshalo, futhi zihlanganisa izinhlobo ezintathu ezahlukene zamaseli: izakhi zemithambo yegazi kanye nama-tracheids (zombili eziqhuba amanzi), kanye ne-xylem parenchyma. Izicubu ze-phloem, ezithutha i-organic com amakhilogremu kusuka endaweni ye-photosynthesis ukuya kwezinye izingxenye zesitshalo, zakhiwe izinhlobo ezine ezahlukene zamaseli: amaseli esivikelo (aqhuba i-photosynthates), amaseli ahambisanayo, i-phloem parenchyma, kanye nemicu ye-phloem. Ngokungafani namaseli aqhuba i-xylem, amaseli aqhuba i-phloem ayaphila ekuvuthweni. I-xylem kanye ne-phloem zihlala ziseduze komunye nomunye (Isithombe 23.3). Eziqwini, i-xylem kanye ne-phloem zakha isakhiwo esibizwa ngokuthi i-vascular bundle; ezimpandeni, lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-vascular stele noma i-vascular cylinder.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.2 Iziqu | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.2 Stems | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Okuqukethwe okuningi okuchazwe kulesi sigaba akukho ngaphakathi kobubanzi be-AP®. Akudingeki ukuthi ubambe ngekhanda izinhlobo ezahlukene zezicubu ezakha isiqu sesitshalo. Kodwa-ke, ku-Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants module sizohlola ngokuningiliziwe indima edlalwa yizicubu zemithambo yegazi (i-xylem ne-phloem), amaseli okuvikela i-epidermal, i-stomata, nama-trichomes ekuphefumuleni, ekumuncweni kwe-carbon dioxide kanye nokukhululwa komoya-mpilo nomhwamuko wamanzi. Ama-Trichomes—izakhiwo ezifana nezinwele ebusweni be-epidermal—nawo avikela amaqabunga ekudliweni (bheka i-Plant Sensory Systems and Reponses module).

 Ngaphandle kwemibono echazwe ku-AP® Connection, ulwazi oluvezwe kule module, kanye nezibonelo ezigqanyisiwe, aluhambisani nokuqukethwe kanye ne-AP® Learning Objectives echazwe ku-AP® Curriculum Framework.

 Iziqu ziyingxenye yesistimu yokudubula yesitshalo. Zingahluka ngobude kusukela kuma-milli ambalwa amamitha kuya kumakhulu amamitha, futhi ziyahlukahluka ngobubanzi, kuye ngohlobo lwesitshalo. Iziqu zivame ukuba ngaphezu komhlabathi, yize iziqu zezinye izitshalo, njengezambane, nazo zikhula ngaphansi komhlabathi. Iziqu zingaba yizitshalo ezithambile noma eziqinile. Umsebenzi wazo oyinhloko ukunikeza ukwesekwa kwesitshalo, zibambe amaqabunga, izimbali namahlumela; kwezinye izimo, iziqu nazo zigcina ukudla kwesitshalo. Isiqu singase singamagatsha, njengesihlahla sesundu, noma singase sibe namagatsha amaningi, njengesihlahla se-magnolia. Isiqu sesitshalo sixhuma izimpande namaqabunga, sisize ukuthutha amanzi adonswayo namaminerali ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesitshalo. Siphinde sisize ukuthutha imikhiqizo ye-photosynthesis, okungukuthi ushukela, kusukela emaqabunga kuya kwesinye isitshalo.

 Iziqu zezitshalo, kungaba ngaphezulu noma ngaphansi komhlabathi, zibonakala ngokuba khona kwamaqhubu nama-internode (Isithombe 23.4). Amaqhubu ayizindawo zokunamathela amaqabunga, izimpande zasemoyeni, nezimbali. Indawo yesiqu ephakathi kwama-node amabili ibizwa ngokuthi i-internode. Isiqu esisuka esiqwini siye eqabeni leqabunga yi-petiole. Ihlumela le-axillary livame ukutholakala e-axil—indawo ephakathi kwesisekelo seqabunga nesiqu—lapho lingaveza khona igatsha noma imbali. I-top (isihloko) sehlumela siqukethe i-apical meristem ngaphakathi kwehlumela le-apical.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.2 Iziqu | I-Anatomy Yesiqu
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.2 Stems | Stem Anatomy
chapterContent:
Isiqu kanye nezinye izitho zezitshalo zivela ezicutshini zomhlabathi, futhi ngokuyinhloko zakhiwe izicubu ezilula ezakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezintathu zamaseli: amaseli e-parenchyma, i-collenchyma, kanye ne-sclerenchyma.

 Amaseli e-parenchyma angamaseli ezitshalo avame kakhulu (Isithombe 23.5). Atholakala esiqwini, empandeni, ngaphakathi kweqabunga, kanye noqweqwe lwesithelo. Amaseli e-parenchyma anesibopho semisebenzi ye-metabolic, njenge-photosynthesis, futhi asiza ekulungiseni nasekuphulukiseni amanxeba. Amanye amaseli e-parenchyma nawo agcina isitashi.

 Amaseli e-Collenchyma angamaseli amade anezindonga ezijiyile ezingalingani (Isithombe 23.6). Anikeza ukwesekwa kwesakhiwo, ikakhulukazi esiqwini nasemaqabungeni. Lawa maseli ayaphila ekuvuthweni futhi avame ukutholakala ngaphansi kwe-epidermis. Izintambo zesiqu se-celery ziyisibonelo samaseli e-collenchyma.

 Amaseli e-Sclerenchyma nawo asekela isitshalo, kodwa ngokungafani namaseli e-collenchyma, amaningi awo afile ekuvuthweni. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zamaseli e-sclerenchyma: imicu kanye nama-sclereids. Zombili izinhlobo zinezindonga zeseli zesibili ezijiyile ngama-deposit e-lignin, i-organic compound eyingxenye ebalulekile yokhuni. Imicu iyizinhlayiya ezinde, ezincane; ama-sclereids amancane ngobukhulu. Ama-Sclereids anika amapheya ukuthungwa kwawo okuqinile. Abantu basebenzisa imicu ye-sclerenchyma ukwenza ilineni nentambo (Isithombe 23.7).

 Njengaso sonke isitshalo, isiqu sinezinhlelo ezintathu zezicubu: isikhumba, izicubu zemithambo yegazi, kanye nezicubu ezingaphansi komhlaba. Ngayinye ihlukaniswa ngezinhlobo zamaseli ezihlukile ezenza imisebenzi ethile edingekayo ekukhuleni nasekusindeni kwesitshalo.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.2 Iziqu | I-Anatomy Yesiqu | Izicubu Zesikhumba
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.2 Stems | Stem Anatomy | Dermal Tissue
chapterContent: Izicubu zesikhumba zesiqu zakhiwe ngokuyinhloko yi-epidermis, ungqimba olulodwa lwamaseli amboza futhi avikele izicubu ezingaphansi. Izitshalo ezinezinkuni zinengqimba yangaphandle eqinile, engangeni manzi yamaseli e-cork eyaziwa ngokuthi i-bark, evikela isitshalo ekulimaleni. Amaseli e-epidermal angamaseli amaningi kakhulu futhi angahlukani kakhulu ku-epidermis. I-epidermis yeqabunga iqukethe nezimbobo ezaziwa ngokuthi i-stomata, lapho ukushintshaniswa kwamagesi kwenzeka khona (Isithombe 23.8). Amaseli amabili, aziwa ngokuthi amaseli okuvikela, azungeze i-stoma ngayinye yeqabunga, elawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwayo futhi ngaleyo ndlela elawula ukumuncwa kwe-carbon dioxide kanye nokukhishwa komoya-mpilo kanye nomhwamuko wamanzi. Ama-Trichomes ayizakhiwo ezifana nezinwele ebusweni be-epidermal. Asiza ekunciphiseni ukugeleza kwamanzi (ukulahlekelwa amanzi yizingxenye zezitshalo ezingaphezulu komhlaba), andise ukukhanya kwelanga, futhi agcine ama-com amakhilogremu avikela amaqabunga ekudliweni yizilwane ezidla uhlaza.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nokusebenza Kwaso | 23. Ifomu Lesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.2 Iziqu | I-Anatomy Yesiqu | Izicubu Zemithambo Yegazi
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.2 Stems | Stem Anatomy | Vascular Tissue
chapterContent:
I-xylem kanye ne-phloem ezakha izicubu zemithambo yesiqu zihlelwe ngemicu ehlukene ebizwa ngokuthi ama-vascular bundles, agijima phezulu naphansi ubude besiqu. Uma isiqu sibhekwa esigabeni esiphambeneyo, ama-vascular bundles eziqu ze-dicot ahlelwe ngendandatho. Ezitshalweni ezineziqu eziphila isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka owodwa, ama-bundles ngamanye akhula ndawonye futhi akhiqize amasongo okukhula ahlukile. Eziqumeni ze-monocot, ama-vascular bundles ahlakazeka ngokungahleliwe kuzo zonke izicubu zomhlabathi (Isithombe 23.9).

 Izicubu ze-Xylem zinezinhlobo ezintathu zamaseli: i-xylem parenchyma, ama-tracheids, kanye nezakhi zemithambo. Izinhlobo ezimbili zokugcina ziqhuba amanzi futhi zifile ekuvuthweni. Ama-tracheids angamaseli e-xylem anezindonga ezinkulu zamaseli esibili ezi-lignified. Amanzi ahamba esuka kwenye i-tracheid aye kwenye ngezifunda ezisodongeni oluseceleni ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-pits, lapho izindonga zesibili zingekho khona. Izakhi zemikhumbi zingamaseli e-xylem anezindonga ezincane; zimfushane kune-tracheids. Isakhi ngasinye semithambo sixhunywe kwesilandelayo ngepuleti lokubhoboza ezindongeni zokugcina zesakhi. Amanzi ahamba ngamapuleti okubhoboza ukuze akhuphukele esitshalweni.

 Izicubu ze-phloem zakhiwe ngamaseli e-sieve-tube, amaseli ahambisanayo, i-phloem parenchyma, kanye nemicu ye-phloem. Uchungechunge lwamaseli e-sieve-tube (abizwa nangokuthi izakhi ze-sieve-tube) luhlelwe kusukela ekugcineni kuya ekugcineni ukuze lwakhe ithubhu elide lokubhoboza, elithutha izinto eziphilayo njengoshukela nama-amino acid. Ushukela ugeleza usuka esiseleni esisodwa se-sieve-tube uye kwesinye ngamapuleti esisefo abhobozekile, atholakala ekugcineni kokuhlangana phakathi kwamaseli amabili. Nakuba esaphila ekuvuthweni, i-nucleus kanye nezinye izingxenye zamaseli e-sieve-tube ziye zahlakazeka. Amaseli ahambisanayo atholakala eceleni kwamaseli e-sieve-tube, ewanikeza ukwesekwa kwe-metabolic. Amaseli ahambisanayo aqukethe ama-ribosome amaningi kanye ne-mitochondria kunamaseli e-sieve-tube, angenazo ezinye i-organelles zeselula.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nokusebenza Kwaso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.2 Iziqu | Ukukhula Kweziqu
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.2 Stems | Growth in Stems
chapterContent:
Ukukhula kwezitshalo kwenzeka njengoba iziqu nezimpande zikhula. Ezinye izitshalo, ikakhulukazi lezo ezinezihlahla, nazo ziyanda ngokuqina ngesikhathi sokuphila kwazo. Ukwanda kobude behlumela kanye nempande kubizwa ngokuthi ukukhula okuyinhloko, futhi kuwumphumela wokuhlukana kwamaseli ehlumela eliyi-apical meristem. Ukukhula kwesibili kubonakala ngokwanda kobukhulu noma ububanzi besitshalo, futhi kubangelwa ukuhlukana kwamaseli e-lateral meristem. Isithombe 23.10 sibonisa izindawo zokukhula okuyinhloko nokwesibili esitshalweni. Izitshalo ezinezihlahla ngokuvamile zikhula ngokuyisisekelo, ngaphandle kokukhula kwesibili noma ukwanda kobukhulu. Ukukhula kwesibili noma ukhuni” kubonakala ezitshalweni ezinezihlahla; kwenzeka kwezinye izihlahla, kodwa kwenzeka kaningi kakhulu kuma-monocot.

 Ezinye izingxenye zezitshalo, njengeziqu nezimpande, ziyaqhubeka nokukhula kuyo yonke impilo yesitshalo: into ebizwa ngokuthi ukukhula okungaqiniseki. Ezinye izingxenye zezitshalo, njengamaqabunga nezimbali, zibonisa ukukhula okuqondile, okuphela lapho ingxenye yesitshalo ifinyelela usayizi othile.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nokusebenza Kwaso | 23. Ifomu Lesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.2 Iziqu | Ukukhula Kweziqu | Ukukhula Okuyinhloko
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.2 Stems | Growth in Stems | Primary Growth
chapterContent:
Ukukhula okuyinhloko okuningi kwenzeka eziqongweni, noma eziqongweni, zeziqu nezimpande. Ukukhula okuyinhloko kuwumphumela wokuhlukanisa ngokushesha amaseli ku-meristems ye-apical eqophelweni lehlumela kanye nephuzu lempande. Ukwandiswa kwamaseli okulandelayo nakho kunegalelo ekukhuleni okuyinhloko. Ukukhula kwamahlumela nezimpande ngesikhathi sokukhula okuyinhloko kwenza izitshalo zihlale zifuna amanzi (izimpande) noma ukukhanya kwelanga (amahlumela).

 Ithonya lehlumela le-apical ekukhuleni kwesitshalo liyaziwa ngokuthi yi-apical dominance, okunciphisa ukukhula kwamahlumela e-axillary akha ezinhlangothini zamagatsha neziqu. Izihlahla eziningi ze-coniferous zibonisa ukubusa okuqinile kwe-apical, ngaleyo ndlela zikhiqize isimo sesihlahla sikaKhisimusi esivamile. Uma ihlumela le-apical lisuswa, khona-ke amahlumela e-axillary azoqala ukwakha amagatsha aseceleni. Abalimi basebenzisa leli qiniso lapho besika izitshalo ngokusika iziqongo zamagatsha, ngaleyo ndlela bakhuthaze amahlumela e-axillary ukuba akhule, okwenza isitshalo sibe nesimo esifana nesihlahla.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nomsebenzi Waso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.2 Iziqu | Ukukhula Kweziqu | Ukukhula Kwesibili
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.2 Stems | Growth in Stems | Secondary Growth
chapterContent:
Ukwanda kobukhulu besiqu obuvela ekukhuleni kwesibili kungenxa yomsebenzi we-lateral meristems, entulekayo ezitshalweni zezitshalo. Ama-lateral meristems afaka i-vascular cambium kanye, ezitshalweni ezinemithi, i-cork cambium (bheka Isithombe 23.10). I-vascular cambium itholakala ngaphandle nje kwe-primary xylem kanye nangaphakathi kwe-primary phloem. Amaseli e-vascular cambium ayahlukana futhi akha i-secondary xylem (ama-tracheids kanye nezakhi zemithambo) ngaphakathi, kanye ne-secondary phloem (izakhi zesihlungo namaseli ahambisanayo) ngaphandle. Ukuqina kwesiqu okwenzeka ekukhuleni kwesibili kungenxa yokwakheka kwe-secondary phloem kanye ne-secondary xylem yi-vascular cambium, kanye nesenzo se-cork cambium, esakha ungqimba oluqinile lwangaphandle lwesiqu. Amaseli e-secondary xylem aqukethe i-lignin, enikeza ukuqina namandla.

 Ezitshalweni ezinemithi, i-cork cambium iyi-lateral meristem engaphandle. Ikhiqiza amaseli e-cork (igxolo) aqukethe into efana ne-wax eyaziwa ngokuthi i-suberin engaxosha amanzi. Igxolo livikela isitshalo ekulimaleni ngokomzimba futhi lisiza ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamanzi. I-cork cambium iphinde ikhiqize ungqimba lwamaseli aziwa ngokuthi i-phelloderm, akhula ngaphakathi esuka ku-cambium. I-cork cambium, amaseli e-cork, kanye ne-phelloderm zibizwa ngokuthi i-periderm. I-periderm ithatha indawo ye-epidermis ezitshalweni ezivuthiwe. Kwezinye izitshalo, i-periderm inezimbobo eziningi, ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-lenticels, avumela amaseli angaphakathi ukushintshanisa amagesi nomoya wangaphandle (Isithombe 23.11). Lokhu kunikeza umoya-mpilo kumaseli aphilayo nasebenzayo e-cortex, i-xylem kanye ne-phloem.

chapterContent: Umsebenzi we-vascular cambium udala izindandatho zokukhula zonyaka. Ngesikhathi sokukhula kwentwasahlobo, amaseli e-xylem yesibili anobubanzi obukhulu bangaphakathi futhi izindonga zawo eziyinhloko zamaseli azijiyile kakhulu. Lokhu kwaziwa ngokuthi ukhuni lokuqala, noma ukhuni lwasentwasahlobo. Ngesikhathi sokuwa, i-xylem yesibili idala izindonga zamaseli ezijiyile, zakha ukhuni lwasekupheleni, noma ukhuni lwasekwindla, oluqinile kunokhuni lokuqala. Lokhu kushintshana kokhuni lokuqala nolwasekupheleni kungenxa yokwehla kwesizini kwenani lezinto zemithambo yegazi kanye nokwanda kwesizini kwenani lama-tracheids. Kuphumela ekwakhekeni kwendandatho yonyaka, engabonakala njengendandatho eyindilinga engxenyeni yesiqu (Isithombe 23.12). Ukuhlolwa kwenani lezindandatho zonyaka kanye nohlobo lwazo (njengosayizi wazo kanye nobukhulu bodonga lwamaseli) kungaveza ubudala bomuthi kanye nezimo zezulu ezikhona phakathi nesizini ngayinye.
question1: Yini ekhiqiza izindandatho zokukhula zonyaka eziqwini ezinjengokhuni?
question2: Yini ehlukanisa ukhuni lokuqala (ukhuni lwasentwasahlobo)?
answer2: Amaseli e-xylem esibili ane-dia enkulu yangaphakathi amamitha kanye nezindonga zamaseli ayinhloko ezincane kakhulu
distractor2a: Amaseli e-xylem esibili anezindonga zesibili ezijiyile kanye ne-dia encane amamitha
question3: Ukhuni olusanda kuzalwa (ukhuni lwasekwindla) luhluke kanjani kokhuni lokuqala?
answer3: Inezindonga zamaseli ezijiyile futhi iqine kakhulu
distractor3b: Inezindonga zamaseli ezincane kanye namaseli amakhulu
question4: Yiluphi ushintsho lwesizini olufaka isandla ekwakhekeni kwezindandatho zonyaka?
answer4: Ukwehla kwezakhi zemithambo yegazi kanye nokwanda kwama-tracheids ngesikhathi sokuwa
question5: Iyini indandatho yonyaka?
answer5: Ingqimba eyindilinga eyakhiwa ukukhiqizwa okushintshana kwezinkuni zakuqala kanye nezinkuni ezisekupheleni ngesikhathi sokukhula
question6: Zibonakala kuphi izindandatho zonyaka?
answer6: Esigabeni esiphambene sesiqu
question7: Yini ososayensi abangayithola ngokubala izindandatho zonyaka?
answer7: Ubudala bomuthi
question8: Ngaphandle kwesikhathi sesihlahla, yini engadalulwa yizindandatho zonyaka?
answer8: Izimo zezulu ngesikhathi ngasinye sonyaka wokukhula

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nomsebenzi Waso | 23. Ifomu Lesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.2 Iziqu | Ukuguqulwa Kwesiqu
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.2 Stems | Stem Modifications
chapterContent:
Ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo zineziqu eziguquliwe ezifanelekela kakhulu indawo ethile yokuhlala nendawo (Isithombe 23.13). I-rhizome iyisiqu esiguquliwe esikhula ngokuvundlile ngaphansi komhlaba futhi sinamaqhubu nama-internode. Amahlumela aqondile angavela emahlumeni ku-rhizome yezinye izitshalo, njenge-ginger nama-fern. Ama-Corm afana nama-rhizome, ngaphandle kokuthi ayindilinga futhi anenyama (njengakuma-gladiolus). Ama-Corm aqukethe ukudla okugciniwe okuvumela ezinye izitshalo ukuthi zisinde ebusika. Ama-Stolon ayiziqu ezigijima cishe zifana nomhlabathi, noma ngaphansi nje kobuso, futhi zingaveza izitshalo ezintsha kumaqhubu. Ama-Runners uhlobo lwe-stolon olugijima ngaphezu komhlabathi futhi lukhiqize izitshalo ezintsha zama-clone kumaqhubu ngezikhathi ezahlukene: ama-strawberry ayisibonelo. Ama-tuber ayiziqu eziguquliwe ezingagcina isitashi, njengoba kubonakala kumazambane (Solanum sp.). Izimila zivela njengeziphetho ezivuvukele ze-stolons, futhi ziqukethe amahlumela amaningi aqhamukayo noma angajwayelekile (ajwayelekile kithi njengamehlo” kumazambane). I-bulb, esebenza njengendawo yokugcina engaphansi komhlaba, ukuguqulwa kwesiqu esibonakala ngamaqabunga amakhulu anenyama avela esiqwini noma azungeze isisekelo sesiqu, njengoba kubonakala ku-iris.

 Ezinye izinguquko zasemoyeni zeziqu ziyizimila nameva (Isithombe 23.14). Izimila ziyimicu emincane, egoqekayo evumela isitshalo (njengomvini noma ithanga) ukuthi sifune ukwesekwa ngokukhuphuka kwezinye izindawo. Ameva angamagatsha aguquliwe avela njengezitshalo ezibukhali ezivikela isitshalo; izibonelo ezivamile zifaka phakathi ama-roses, i-Osage orange kanye ne-devil’s walking stick

answer3: Ukugcina ukudla okusiza ezinye izitshalo ukuba zisinde ebusika

answer4: Iziqu ezicishe zihambisane noma ngaphansi komhlaba futhi zingakhiqiza izitshalo ezintsha kuma-node
question5: Abagijimi bahluke kanjani kwamanye ama-stolons?
answer5: Zigijima ngaphezu komhlabathi futhi zikhiqize izitshalo ezintsha ze-clone kuma-node
distractor5c: Zigcina isitashi kodwa azikwazi ukuzala kabusha
question6: Yisiphi isiqu esiguquliwe esigcina isitashi futhi esinamehlo afana namahlumela aqhamukayo?
answer6: I-Tuber
question7: Liyini iso lezambane?
answer7: Ihlumela elivelayo esiqwini

answer8: Isiqu esiguquliwe esisebenza njengendawo yokugcina ngaphansi komhlaba enamaqabunga amakhulu anamanzi azungeze isiqu
answer9: Zisiza izitshalo ukuba zikhuphuke futhi zifune ukwesekwa ngokuzihlanganisa zizungeze izindawo

answer11: Ziyiziqu ezikhethekile ezilungiselelwe ukugcinwa, ukuzala kabusha, ukusekela, noma ukuvikela

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.3 Izimpande | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.3 Roots | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Okuqukethwe okuningi okuchazwe kulesi sigaba, ikakhulukazi i-root anatomy, akukho ngaphakathi kobubanzi be-AP®. Kodwa-ke, ku-Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants module, sizohlola indima yezimpande ekumunceni amanzi adingekayo kwi-photosynthesis, ekuthuthweni kwamaminerali nezinye izakhamzimba, nasekugcineni ama-carbohydrate.

 Lapho sihlola i-mitosis esahlukweni Sokukhiqiza Amaseli, kungenzeka ukuthi uhlole i-root meristem ngaphansi kwe-microscope. I-meristem yakhiwe ngokuhlukanisa amaseli ngenkuthalo. Kodwa-ke, njengezitho zezilwane nezinhlelo zezitho, izakhiwo zezitshalo, okuhlanganisa nezimpande, ziyasebenzisana ukuze zinikeze imisebenzi ethile. Isibonelo, amanzi amuncwa ohlelweni lwezimpande futhi ahamba aye phezulu nge-xylem aye emaqabunga, lapho esetshenziswa khona kwi-photosynthesis. (Bheka i-Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants module.)

 Ngaphandle kwezimo ezichazwe ku-AP® Connection, ulwazi oluvezwe kulesi sigaba, kanye nezibonelo ezigqanyisiwe, aluhambisani nokuqukethwe kanye ne-AP® Learning Objectives ezichazwe ku-AP® Curriculum Framework.

 Izimpande zezitshalo zembewu zinemisebenzi emithathu emikhulu: ukunamathelisa isitshalo enhlabathini, ukumunca amanzi namaminerali bese ziwathutha ziye phezulu, nokugcina imikhiqizo ye-photosynthesis. Ezinye izimpande ziyaguqulwa ukuze zimunce umswakama futhi zishintshe amagesi. Izimpande eziningi zingaphansi komhlaba. Nokho, ezinye izitshalo zinezimpande eziphumayo, eziphuma ngaphezu komhlabathi kusukela ehlumela.
question1: Iyini indima eyinhloko yezimpande ekumunceni amanzi?
answer1: Ukumunca amanzi enhlabathini ukuze athuthwe kuso sonke isitshalo
question2: Yisiphi izicubu zemithambo yegazi ezithutha amanzi amuncwa yizimpande ziye kwesinye isitshalo?
question3: Uyini umsebenzi we-root meristem?
answer3: Iqukethe amaseli ahlukanisa ngenkuthalo abhekene nokukhula kwezimpande
question4: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeyona ingxenye enkulu yezimpande zezitshalo zembewu?
answer4: Ukuthatha ukukhanya kwelanga ukuze kwenziwe i-photosynthesis
question5: Amanzi amuncwa kanjani yizimpande kanye ne-photosynthesis?
answer5: Amanzi amuncwa yizimpande athuthelwa emaqabungeni lapho asetshenziswa khona ku-photosynthesis
distractor5a: Amanzi amuncwa yizimpande aguqulwa ngqo abe ushukela ezimpandeni
question6: Ziyini izimpande ezizivukelayo?
answer6: Izimpande eziphuma ngaphezu komhlabathi kusukela ehlumela
question7: Ngaphandle kokumunca amanzi namaminerali, yimuphi omunye umsebenzi obalulekile wezimpande?
answer7: Ukugcina imikhiqizo ye-photosynthesis

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.3 Izimpande | Izinhlobo Zezinhlelo Zezimpande
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.3 Roots | Types of Root Systems
chapterContent: Izinhlelo zezimpande zizinhlobo ezimbili ikakhulukazi (Isithombe 23.15). Ama-Dicot anesistimu yezimpande ezimpompini, kanti ama-monocot anesistimu yezimpande ezinemicu. Uhlelo lwezimpande ezimpompini lunempande eyinhloko ekhula iqonde phansi, futhi okuvela kuyo izimpande eziningi ezincane eziseceleni. Ama-Dandelion ayisibonelo esihle; izimpande zawo ezimpompini zivame ukuphuka lapho zizama ukudonsa lolu khula, futhi zingaphinde zikhule olunye ukhula empandeni esele). Uhlelo lwezimpande ezimpompini lungena lujule enhlabathini. Ngokuphambene nalokho, uhlelo lwezimpande ezinemicu luseduze nobuso bomhlabathi, futhi lwakha inethiwekhi ebanzi yezimpande esiza nasekuvimbeleni ukuguguleka komhlabathi (utshani botshani buyisibonelo esihle, njengoba kunjalo nangokolweni, ilayisi, nommbila). Ezinye izitshalo zinenhlanganisela yezimpande ezimpompini kanye nezimpande ezinemicu. Izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni ezomile zivame ukuba nesistimu yezimpande ezijulile, kanti izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni ezinamanzi amaningi cishe zinesistimu yezimpande ezingajulile.
question1: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesistimu yezimpande oluyisici sama-dicot amaningi?
question2: Yiluphi uhlobo lwesistimu yezimpande oluyisici sama-monocot amaningi?
question3: Iyini isici esichazayo sesistimu yezimpande ezimpompini?
answer3: Impande eyodwa eyinhloko ikhula iqonde phansi kanye nezimpande ezincane eziseceleni eziqhamuka kuyo
distractor3a: Izimpande eziningi ezilinganayo zisakazeke eduze komhlabathi
question4: Iyini inzuzo ebalulekile yesistimu yezimpande enemicu?
answer4: Kusiza ekuvimbeleni ukuguguleka kwenhlabathi ngokwakha inethiwekhi ebanzi yezimpande
distractor4a: Igcina ama-carbohydrate amaningi kunanoma yiziphi ezinye izinhlobo zezimpande
distractor4c: Ithutha ushukela ngendlela ephumelela kakhulu kune-phloem
question5: Yisiphi kulezi zitshalo ezilandelayo esiyisibonelo sesistimu yezimpande ezinemicu?
answer5: Ukolweni
question6: Izimpande zivame ukuhluka kanjani phakathi kwezitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni ezomile nezimanzi?
answer6: Izitshalo ezindaweni ezomile zivame ukuba nezimpande ezijulile, kanti izitshalo ezindaweni ezimanzi zivame ukuba nezimpande ezingajulile.
distractor6a: Izitshalo ezindaweni ezomile zihlala zinezimpande ezinemicu, kanti izitshalo ezisendaweni emanzi zihlala zinezimpande ezimanzi
distractor6b: Izitshalo ezindaweni ezimanzi azinazo izimpande eziseceleni
distractor6c: Izitshalo ezindaweni ezomile zinezimpande ezikhula ngaphezu komhlabathi
question7: Yisiphi isitshalo esiyisibonelo esivamile sesistimu yezimpande ezimpompini?
answer7: I-Dandelion

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.3 Izimpande | Ukukhula Kwezimpande Nokwakheka Kwazo
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.3 Roots | Root Growth and Anatomy
chapterContent:
Ukukhula kwezimpande kuqala ngokuhluma kwembewu. Lapho umbungu wesitshalo uphuma embewini, i-radicle yombungu yakha uhlelo lwempande. Isihloko sempande sivikelwe yisivalo sempande, isakhiwo esikhethekile ezimpandeni futhi esingafani nanoma yisiphi esinye isakhiwo sesitshalo. Isivalo sempande sishintshwa njalo ngoba sonakala kalula njengoba impande idlula enhlabathini. Isihloko sempande singahlukaniswa sibe yizindawo ezintathu: indawo yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli, indawo yokunwebeka, kanye nendawo yokuvuthwa nokuhlukaniswa (Isithombe 23.16). Indawo yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli iseduze nesihloko sempande; yakhiwe ngamaseli ahlukanisayo ngenkuthalo ezimpande ze-meristem. Indawo yokunwebeka yilapho amaseli asanda kwakheka ekhula khona ngobude, ngaleyo ndlela enweba impande. Kusukela ezinweleni zokuqala zempande yindawo yokuvuthwa kwamaseli lapho amaseli ezimpande eqala khona ukuhlukana abe izinhlobo zamaseli ezikhethekile. Zonke izindawo ezintathu zikusentimitha lokuqala noma ngaphezulu kwesihloko sempande.

 Impande inengqimba yangaphandle yamaseli ebizwa ngokuthi i-epidermis, ezungeze izindawo zezicubu zomhlabathi kanye nezicubu zemithambo yegazi. I-epidermis inikeza isivikelo futhi iyasiza ekumuncweni. Izinwele zezimpande, eziyizandiso zamaseli e-epidermal ezimpande, zandisa indawo engaphezulu yempande, zinegalelo elikhulu ekumuncweni kwamanzi namaminerali.

 Ngaphakathi kwempande, izicubu zomhlabathi zakha izifunda ezimbili: i-cortex kanye ne-pith (Isithombe 23.17). Uma kuqhathaniswa neziqu, izimpande zine-cortex eningi kanye ne-pith encane. Zombili lezi zifunda zifaka amaseli agcina imikhiqizo ye-photosynthetic. I-cortex iphakathi kwe-epidermis kanye nezicubu zemithambo yegazi, kanti i-pith iphakathi kwezicubu zemithambo yegazi kanye nendawo ephakathi kwempande.

 Izicubu zemithambo yegazi empandeni zihlelwe engxenyeni engaphakathi yempande, ebizwa ngokuthi i-stele (Isithombe 23.18). Ungqimba lwamaseli aziwa ngokuthi i-endodermis luhlukanisa i-stele nezicubu zomhlabathi engxenyeni engaphandle yempande. I-endodermis itholakala kuphela ezimpandeni, futhi isebenza njengendawo yokuhlola izinto ezingena ohlelweni lwemithambo yegazi yempande. Into efana ne-wax ebizwa ngokuthi i-suberin ikhona ezindongeni zamaseli e-endodermal. Lesi sifunda esinongwevu, esaziwa ngokuthi i-Casparian strip, siphoqa amanzi kanye nezinhlayiya ukuba ziwele ulwelwesi lwe-plasma lwamaseli e-endodermal esikhundleni sokushelela phakathi kwamaseli. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezidingekayo yimpande kuphela ezidlula ku-endodermis, kuyilapho izinto ezinobuthi kanye namagciwane ngokuvamile zingafakwa. Ingqimba yeseli engaphandle yezicubu zemithambo yempande yi-pericycle, indawo engadala izimpande eziseceleni. Ezimpandeni ze-dicot, i-xylem kanye ne-phloem ye-stele zihlelwe ngokushintshana ngesimo se-X, kanti ezimpandeni ze-monocot, izicubu zemithambo zihlelwe ngendandatho ezungeze i-pith.

answer2: Ukuvikela isihloko sempande njengoba sidlula enhlabathini

answer4: Ukwandisa indawo engaphezulu yokumuncwa kwamanzi namaminerali

answer5: Iphoqa amanzi kanye nezincibilikisi ukuthi zidlule ezingxeni zeseli ze-endodermal, zilawule ukungena kwezicubu zemithambo yegazi.

answer7: Zihlelwe ngokwahlukana ngephethini efana no-X ngaphakathi kwetshe
question8: Liyini igama lesilinda semithambo ephakathi yempande?
answer8: Itshe

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nomsebenzi Waso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.3 Izimpande | Ukuguqulwa Kwezimpande
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.3 Roots | Root Modifications
chapterContent:
Izakhiwo zezimpande zingashintshwa ngezinjongo ezithile. Isibonelo, ezinye izimpande zinkulu futhi zigcina isitashi. Izimpande zasemoyeni kanye nezimpande ze-prop ziyizinhlobo ezimbili zezimpande ezingaphezulu komhlaba ezinikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe ukuze ziqinise isitshalo. Izimpande ze-tap, njengezaqathi, ama-turnip, nama-beet, ziyizibonelo zezimpande ezishintshwayo ukuze zigcine ukudla (Isithombe 23.19).

 Izimpande ze-Epiphytic zivumela isitshalo ukuthi sikhule kwesinye isitshalo. Isibonelo, izimpande ze-epiphytic zama-orchid zakha izicubu ezithambile ukuze zimunce umswakama. Umuthi we-banyan (i-Ficus sp.) uqala njenge-epiphyte, ukhula emagatsheni esihlahla esisingethwe; izimpande zasemoyeni ziyakhula emagatsheni futhi ekugcineni zifinyelele emhlabathini, zinikeze ukwesekwa okwengeziwe (Isithombe 23.20). Ku-screwpine (i-Pandanus sp.), umuthi ofana nesundu okhula enhlabathini enesihlabathi eshisayo, izimpande ze-prop ezingaphezulu komhlaba ziyakhula emaqhubu ukuze zinikeze ukwesekwa okwengeziwe
question1: Kungani ezinye izimpande ziguqulwa zibe yizigaxa?

question3: Yisiphi kulezi zitshalo ezilandelayo esinezimpande ezithambile ezilungisiwe ukuze zigcinwe ukudla?
question4: Uyini umsebenzi wezimpande ze-epiphytic kuma-orchid?
answer4: Ukuze umunce umswakama usebenzisa izicubu ezikhethekile ezithambile
question5: Iyini i-epiphyte?
answer5: Isitshalo esikhula kwesinye isitshalo ngaphandle kokumila izimpande enhlabathini
distractor5c: Isitshalo esithola zonke izakhamzimba zaso ngokufaka esinye isitshalo esikhumbeni
question6: Izimpande zasemoyeni zizuzisa kanjani isihlahla se-banyan?
answer6: Zikhula kusukela emagatsheni ziye phansi futhi zinikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe kwesakhiwo
question7: Kungani i-screwpine ikhula izimpande ze-prop kusuka kuma-node ayo?
answer7: Ukunikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe enhlabathini enesihlabathi eshisayo

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nomsebenzi Waso | 23. Ifomu Lesitshalo kanye Nesayensi Yomzimba | Amaqabunga angu-23.4 | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.4 Leaves | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Izitshalo zinamaqabunga akhethekile ajwayele izindawo zazo ezithile. Isibonelo, amaqabunga ezitshalo ezikhula emahlathini emvula anendawo enkulu kune-cacti ekhula ehlane noma ezimweni ezibandayo kakhulu, lapho indawo yayo encane inciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi ngokuphefumula. I-cuticle ene-wax imboza ubuso bazo zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo ukunciphisa izinga lokulahleka kwamanzi ebusweni beqabunga. Amanye amaqabunga angaba nezinwele ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-trichomes ebusweni beqabunga; ama-trichomes awasizi nje kuphela ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamanzi; avikela futhi iqabunga ezitshalweni ngokuvimbela ukunyakaza kwezinambuzane noma ngokugcina amakhemikhali anobuthi noma anambitheka kabi.

 Ulwazi oluvezwe kule module aluhambisani nokuqukethwe kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ze-AP® ezichazwe ku-AP® Curriculum Framework. Indima ye-stomata, amaseli okuvikela, kanye nama-trichomes ekuphefumuleni ihlolwe ku-Transport of Water kanye ne-Solutes in Plants module.

 Amaqabunga ayizindawo eziyinhloko ze-photosynthesis: inqubo lapho izitshalo zenza ukudla. Amaqabunga amaningi avame ukuba luhlaza, ngenxa yokuba khona kwe-chlorophyll emangqamuzaneni amaqabunga. Kodwa-ke, amanye amaqabunga angase abe nemibala ehlukene, okubangelwa ezinye izinhlayiya zezitshalo ezifihla i-chlorophyll eluhlaza.

 Ubukhulu, ukuma, nobukhulu bamaqabunga kuhambisana nendawo ezungezile. Ukwehlukahluka ngakunye kusiza uhlobo lwesitshalo ukuthi lukhulise amathuba alo okusinda endaweni ethile yokuhlala. Ngokuvamile, amaqabunga ezitshalo ezikhula emahlathini emvula asezindaweni ezishisayo anezindawo ezinkulu zobuso kunezitshalo ezikhula ezingwadule noma ezimweni ezibandayo kakhulu, okungenzeka zibe nendawo encane yobuso ukuze kuncishiswe ukulahleka kwamanzi.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nokusebenza Kwaso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.4 Amaqabunga | Isakhiwo Seqabunga Elijwayelekile
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.4 Leaves | Structure of a Typical Leaf
chapterContent:
Iqabunga ngalinye livame ukuba nekhasi elibizwa ngokuthi i-lamina, eliyingxenye ebanzi kakhulu yeqabunga. Amanye amaqabunga anamathele esiqwini sesitshalo yi-petiole. Amaqabunga angenayo i-petiole futhi anamathele ngqo esiqwini sesitshalo abizwa ngokuthi amaqabunga e-sessile. Izithako ezincane eziluhlaza ezivame ukutholakala phansi kwe-petiole zaziwa ngokuthi ama-stipules. Amaqabunga amaningi anomphetho ophakathi, ohamba ubude beqabunga namagatsha ohlangothini ngalunye ukuze akhiqize imithambo yezicubu zemithambo. Umphetho weqabunga ubizwa ngokuthi umkhawulo. Isithombe 23.21 sibonisa isakhiwo seqabunga elijwayelekile le-eudicot.

 Ngaphakathi kweqabunga ngalinye, izicubu zemithambo zakha imithambo. Ukuhleleka kwemithambo eqabungeni kubizwa ngokuthi iphethini ye-venation. Ama-monocot nama-dicot ahlukile emaphethini awo e-venation (Isithombe 23.22). Ama-monocot ane-venation efanayo; imithambo igijima ngemigqa eqondile kulo lonke ubude beqabunga ngaphandle kokuhlangana endaweni ethile. Nokho, kuma-dicot, imithambo yeqabunga inokubukeka okufana nenethi, yakha iphethini eyaziwa ngokuthi i-reticulate venation. Esinye isitshalo esikhona, i-Gin kg o biloba, ine-dichotomous venation lapho imithambo ihlangana khona.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nomsebenzi Waso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.4 Amaqabunga | Ukuhleleka Kwamaqabunga
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.4 Leaves | Leaf Arrangement
chapterContent: Ukuhleleka kwamaqabunga esiqwini kwaziwa ngokuthi i-phyllotaxy. Inani kanye nokubekwa kwamaqabunga esitshalo kuzohluka kuye ngohlobo, uhlobo ngalunye lukhombisa ukuhlelwa kwamaqabunga okuhlukile. Amaqabunga ahlukaniswa ngokuthi ahlukile, ajikelezayo, noma aphambene. Izitshalo ezineqabunga elilodwa kuphela ngeqhubu ngalinye zinamaqabunga okuthiwa ahlukile - okusho ukuthi amaqabunga ashintshana ohlangothini ngalunye lwesiqu endaweni eyisicaba - noma ajikelezayo, okusho ukuthi amaqabunga ahlelwe ngendlela ejikelezayo esiqwini. Ekuhleleni kwamaqabunga okuphambene, amaqabunga amabili avela endaweni efanayo, amaqabunga exhumanisana eduze kwegatsha. Uma kunamaqabunga amathathu noma ngaphezulu axhunywe kuqhubu, ukuhlelwa kwamaqabunga kuhlukaniswa ngokuthi ahlanganisiwe

answer3: Iqabunga elilodwa ngeqhubu, lishintshana ohlangothini ngalunye lwesiqu

distractor4c: Amaqabunga amathathu anamathiselwe kuyo yonke i-node

distractor5b: Kuvela iqabunga elilodwa kuphela esiqwini sonke
distractor5c: Amaqabunga ahlelwe ngendlela ejikelezayo ezungeze izimpande

answer6: Amaqabunga amathathu noma ngaphezulu avela eqhulwini elifanayo

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nomsebenzi Waso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.4 Amaqabunga | Isakhiwo Seqabunga
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.4 Leaves | Leaf Form
chapterContent: Amaqabunga angaba lula noma abe yinhlanganisela (Isithombe 23.23). Eqabungeni elilula, i-blade ayihlukanisiwe ngokuphelele—njengaseqabungeni lebhanana—noma inama-lobes, kodwa ukuhlukana akufinyeleli embanjeni ephakathi, njengaseqabungeni le-maple. Eqabungeni elihlanganisiwe, i-blade leqabu lihlukanisiwe ngokuphelele, lakha amapheshana, njengasesihlahleni se-locust. Ipheshana ngalinye lingaba nesiqu salo, kodwa linamathele ku-rachis. Iqabu elihlanganisiwe elifana nesundu lifana nesandla sesandla, namapheshana aphuma ngaphandle esuka endaweni eyodwa Izibonelo zifaka amaqabunga e-poison ivy, umuthi we-buckeye, noma isitshalo sasekhaya esijwayelekile i-Schefflera sp. (igama elivamile isitshalo se-umbrella). Amaqabunga ahlanganisiwe athatha igama lawo ngokubukeka kwawo okufana nezimpaphe; amapheshana ahlelwe eceleni kwembanjeni ephakathi, njengasemaqabungeni e-rose (Rosa sp.), noma amaqabunga ezihlahla ze-hickory, pecan, ash, noma i-walnut
question1: Uyini umehluko omkhulu phakathi kweqabunga elilula neqabunga elihlanganisiwe?
answer1: Iqabunga elilula linekhasi elilodwa, kanti iqabunga elihlanganisiwe lihlukaniswe ngamapheshana
distractor1a: Iqabunga elilula linemithambo, kanti iqabunga elihlanganisiwe alinawo
distractor1c: Iqabunga elihlanganisiwe lihlala line-blade eyodwa engahlukanisiwe

question3: Yisiphi isakhiwo esixhumanisa amapheshana eqabungeni elihlanganisiwe?
question4: Yini isici seqabunga elihlanganiswe ngesundu?
answer4: Amapheshana akhanya ngaphandle esuka endaweni eyodwa njengeminwe yesandla
distractor4a: Amapheshana ahlelwe eceleni kwe-axis ephakathi njengophaphe
distractor4c: Imithambo igijima ngokulingana kusukela phansi kuya esicongweni
question5: Yisiphi isitshalo esiyisibonelo seqabunga elihlanganiswe ngesundu?
answer5: I-ivy enobuthi
question6: Amapheshana ahlelwe kanjani eqabungeni elihlanganisiwe kahle?
answer6: Eceleni kwe-axis ephakathi, okwenza iqabunga libukeke njengempaphe
distractor6a: Ukukhanya okuvela ngaphandle kusuka endaweni eyodwa
question7: Yisiphi kulezi zitshalo ezilandelayo esinamaqabunga ahlanganiswe kahle?
answer7: I-Rose

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nomsebenzi Waso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nomzimba Waso | 23.4 Amaqabunga | Isakhiwo Seqabunga Nomsebenzi Waso
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.4 Leaves | Leaf Structure and Function
chapterContent:
Ingqimba engaphandle yeqabunga yi-epidermis; ikhona kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zeqabunga futhi ibizwa ngokuthi i-epidermis ephezulu nephansi, ngokulandelana. Ososayensi bezitshalo babiza uhlangothi olungaphezulu ngokuthi ubuso be-adaxial (noma i-adaxis) kanti uhlangothi olungezansi ngokuthi ubuso be-abaxial (noma i-abaxis). I-epidermis iyasiza ekulawuleni ukushintshana kwegesi. Iqukethe i-stomata (Isithombe 23.24): izimbobo lapho ukushintshana kwamagesi kwenzeka khona. Amaseli amabili okuvikela azungeze i-stoma ngayinye, elawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwayo.

 I-epidermis ivame ukuba ungqimba lweseli olulodwa; noma kunjalo, ezitshalweni ezikhula ezimweni ezishisa kakhulu noma ezibandayo kakhulu, i-epidermis ingaba ugqinsi lwezingqimba eziningana ukuvikela ekulahlekelweni kwamanzi ngokweqile ekuphefumuleni. Ingqimba efana ne-wax eyaziwa ngokuthi i-cuticle imboza amaqabunga azo zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo. I-cuticle inciphisa izinga lokulahleka kwamanzi ebusweni beqabunga. Amanye amaqabunga angaba nezinwele ezincane (ama-trichomes) ebusweni beqabunga. Ama-Trichomes asiza ekuvimbeleni ukhula lwezitshalo ngokuvimbela ukunyakaza kwezinambuzane, noma ngokugcina i-com enobuthi noma enganambitheki kahle amakhilogremu; anganciphisa nezinga lokuphefumula ngokuvimbela ukugeleza komoya phezu kweqabunga (Isithombe 23.25).

 Ngaphansi kwe-epidermis yamaqabunga e-dicot kunezingqimba zamaseli aziwa ngokuthi i-mesophyll, noma iqabunga eliphakathi. I-mesophyll yamaqabunga amaningi ngokuvamile iqukethe amalungiselelo amabili amaseli e-parenchyma: i-palisade parenchyma kanye ne-spongy parenchyma (Isithombe 23.26). I-palisade parenchyma (ebizwa nangokuthi i-palisade mesophyll) inamaseli amise okwekholomu, ahlanganiswe kahle, futhi angaba khona ngqimbeni eyodwa, ezimbili, noma ezintathu. Ngaphansi kwe-palisade parenchyma kunamaseli ahlelekile angahlelekile anesimo esingajwayelekile. Lawa amaseli e-spongy parenchyma (noma i-spongy mesophyll). Isikhala somoya esitholakala phakathi kwamaseli e-spongy parenchyma sivumela ukushintshana kwegesi phakathi kweqabunga nomoya wangaphandle nge-stomata. Ezitshalweni zasemanzini, izikhala eziphakathi kwamaseli ku-spongy parenchyma zisiza iqabunga ukuthi lintante. Zombili izingqimba ze-mesophyll ziqukethe ama-chloroplast amaningi. Amaseli okuqapha yiwona kuphela amaseli e-epidermal aqukethe ama-chloroplast.

 Njengesiqu, iqabunga liqukethe izinqwaba zemithambo yegazi ezakhiwe yi-xylem kanye ne-phloem (Isithombe 23.27). I-xylem yakhiwe ngama-tracheids nemithambo yegazi, ethutha amanzi namaminerali aye emaqabunga. I-phloem ithutha imikhiqizo ye-photosynthetic esuka eqabungeni iye kwezinye izingxenye zesitshalo. Inqwaba eyodwa yemithambo yegazi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi inkulu noma incane kangakanani, ihlala iqukethe izicubu ze-xylem neze-phloem.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Nokusebenza Kwaso | 23. Isakhiwo Sesitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.4 Amaqabunga | Ukuzivumelanisa Nezimo Zamaqabunga
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.4 Leaves | Leaf Adaptations
chapterContent: Izinhlobo zezitshalo ze-coniferous ezikhula kahle ezindaweni ezibandayo, njenge-spruce, i-fir, ne-pine, zinamaqabunga ancishisiwe ngobukhulu futhi abukeka njengenaliti. Lawa maqabunga afana nenaliti ane-stomata etshonile kanye nendawo encane ebusweni: izici ezimbili ezisiza ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamanzi. Ezimweni ezishisayo, izitshalo ezifana ne-cacti zinamaqabunga ancishisiwe abe yizinsika, ezihambisana neziqu zazo ezinamanzi, ezisiza ukonga amanzi. Izitshalo eziningi zasemanzini zinamaqabunga ane-lamina ebanzi engantanta phezu kwamanzi, kanye ne-cuticle ejiyile ene-wax ebusweni beqabunga exosha amanzi

answer1: Zifana nenaliti, zinendawo encane ebusweni kanye ne-stomata etshonile ukuze kuncishiswe ukulahleka kwamanzi
distractor1a: Zibanzi futhi zincane ukuze zikwazi ukuphefumulela kahle

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.4 Amaqabunga | Ukuzivumelanisa Nezitshalo Ezindaweni Ezingenazo Izinsizakusebenza
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.4 Leaves | Plant Adaptations in Resource-Deficient Environments
chapterContent:
Izimpande, iziqu, namaqabunga akhiwe ngendlela yokuqinisekisa ukuthi isitshalo singathola ukukhanya kwelanga okudingekayo, amanzi, izakhamzimba zomhlabathi, kanye nezinsiza ze-oxygen. Ezinye izinguquko eziphawulekayo ziye zavela ukuze kuvunyelwe izinhlobo zezitshalo ukuba zichume ezindaweni zokuhlala ezingafanele, lapho enye noma ngaphezulu yalezi zinsiza ingekho khona.

 Emahlathini emvula asezindaweni ezishisayo, ukukhanya kuvame ukuntuleka, njengoba izihlahla nezitshalo eziningi zikhula eduze futhi zivimbele ukukhanya kwelanga okuningi ukuthi kungafiki phansi ehlathini. Izinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo zasezindaweni ezishisayo zinamaqabunga abanzi kakhulu ukuze kukhuliswe ukuthunjwa kwelanga. Ezinye izinhlobo yi-epiphyte: izitshalo ezikhula kwezinye izitshalo ezisebenza njengokusekelwa ngokomzimba. Izitshalo ezinjalo ziyakwazi ukukhula phezulu emphemeni phezu kwamagatsha eminye imithi, lapho ukukhanya kwelanga kuningi khona. Ama-Epiphyte aphila emvuleni namaminerali aqoqwe emagatsheni nasemaqabungeni esitshalo esisekelayo. Ama-Bromeliad (amalungu omndeni wephayinaphu), ama-fern, nama-orchid ayizibonelo zama-epiphyte asezindaweni ezishisayo (Isithombe 23.28). Ama-epiphyte amaningi anezicubu ezikhethekile eziwenza akwazi ukubamba nokugcina amanzi ngempumelelo.

 Ezinye izitshalo zinezindlela ezikhethekile zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezizisiza ukuba ziphile ezindaweni ezingenazo izakhamzimba. Izitshalo ezidla inyama, njenge-Venus flytrap kanye nesitshalo se-pitcher (Isithombe 23.29), zikhula emaxhaphozini lapho inhlabathi ingenayo i-nitrogen eningi khona. Kulezi zitshalo, amaqabunga ayaguqulwa ukuze abambe izinambuzane. Amaqabunga abamba izinambuzane kungenzeka ukuthi ashintshe ukuze anikeze lezi zitshalo umthombo owengeziwe we-nitrogen edingekayo kakhulu.

 Izitshalo eziningi zamaxhaphozi zinezindlela zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ezizivumela ukuba zichume ezindaweni ezimanzi, lapho izimpande zazo zikhula ngaphansi kwamanzi. Kulezi zindawo zasemanzini, inhlabathi ayizinzile futhi i-oxygen encane iyatholakala ukuze ifinyelele ezimpandeni. Izihlahla ezifana ne-mangrove (Rhizophora sp.) ezikhula emanzini asogwini zikhiqiza izimpande ezingaphezulu komhlaba ezisiza ukusekela isihlahla (Isithombe 23.30). Ezinye izinhlobo ze-mangrove, kanye nezihlahla ze-cypress, zine-pneumatophores: izimpande ezikhula phezulu eziqukethe izikhala kanye nezikhala zezicubu ezikhethekile zokushintshana ngegesi. Ilayisi lasendle liyisitshalo sasemanzini esinezikhala ezinkulu zomoya ku-cortex yezimpande. Izicubu ezigcwele umoya—ezibizwa ngokuthi i-aerenchyma—zihlinzeka ngendlela yokuthi umoya-mpilo usabalale uye eziqongweni zezimpande, ezifakwe enhlabathini engezansi engenawo umoya-mpilo.

answer1: Ukuze kutholakale ukukhanya kwelanga okukhulu ezindaweni ezinokukhanya okuphansi

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.5 Ukuthuthwa Kwamanzi Nezinto Ezincibilikayo Ezitshalweni | Ukuxhumeka Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ulwazi olukulesi sigaba lusebenza emiqondweni esiyihlolile ezahlukweni ezedlule ngokuyixhumanisa nokuthuthwa kwamanzi kanye ne-solutes ngesitshalo, okubonisa izindlela izitshalo ezithatha futhi zithuthe ngazo izinto. Le mibono ihlanganisa izinqubo ze-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumula kwamaseli, izakhiwo zamakhemikhali nezomzimba zamanzi, kanye nokuguquka kwezitshalo ezinamabhaktheriya ahambisanayo kanye ne-fungi. Uhlelo lwemithambo yegazi yezitshalo zomhlaba luvumela ukumuncwa kanye nokulethwa kwamanzi ngendlela ephumelelayo ngamaseli aqukethe i-xylem, kuyilapho i-phloem iletha ushukela okhiqizwa yi-photosynthesis kuzo zonke izingxenye zesitshalo, kufaka phakathi izimpande zokugcina. Ukuhlukaniswa ngokomzimba kwe-xylem kanye ne-phloem kuvumela izitshalo ukuthi zithuthe izakhamzimba ezahlukene ngesikhathi esisodwa kusuka ezimpandeni kuya emahlumela kanye nokuphikisana nalokho. Cishe zonke izitshalo zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlobene ze-osmoregulation, futhi sizogxila ekuthuthweni kwamanzi nezinye izakhamzimba.

 Cishe uyakhumbula umqondo wamandla wamanzi (Ψ) ekuhloleni kwethu ukusabalala kanye ne-osmosis esahlukweni lapho sixoxa khona ngesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi we-plasma membranes. Amandla wamanzi ayisilinganiso somehluko wamandla angaba khona phakathi kwesampula yamanzi ene-solutes namanzi ahlanzekile. Amanzi ahamba nge-osmosis esuka endaweni enamandla amanzi amaningi (ama-molecule amanzi amaningi, i-solute encane) aye endaweni enamandla amanzi aphansi (amanzi amancane, i-solute eyengeziwe). Amandla amanzi ezixazululweni zezitshalo athonywa ukuhlushwa kwe-solute, ingcindezi, amandla adonsela phansi, nezinye izici (imiphumela ye-matrix). Amandla amanzi kanye nokuphefumulela kuthonya indlela amanzi athuthwa ngayo nge-xylem.

 Ama-carbohydrate akhiqizwa ku-photosynthesis, ikakhulukazi i-sucrose, ahamba esuka emithonjeni aye ekucwileni nge-phloem yesitshalo. I-Sucrose ekhiqizwa emjikelezweni kaCalvin ifakwa ezingxenyeni ze-sieve-tube ze-phloem, futhi ukuhlushwa kwe-solute okwandisiwe kubangela amanzi ukuba ahambe nge-osmosis esuka ku-xylem aye ku-phloem.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Uhlobo Lwezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.5 Ukuthuthwa Kwamanzi Nezinto Ezincibilikayo Ezitshalweni | Amandla Amanzi
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants | Water Potential
chapterContent:
Izitshalo zingonjiniyela be-hydraulic abamangalisayo. Zisebenzisa imithetho eyisisekelo yefiziksi kanye nokuphathwa okulula kwamandla angase abe khona, izitshalo zingahambisa amanzi ziye phezulu kwesihlahla esingamamitha angu-116 ubude (Isithombe 23.31a). Izitshalo zingasebenzisa futhi ama-hydraulic ukukhiqiza amandla anele okuhlukanisa amatshe nokubopha izindlela zokuhamba ngezinyawo (Isithombe 23.31b). Izitshalo zifinyelela lokhu ngenxa yamandla amanzi.

 Amandla amanzi ayisilinganiso samandla angase abe khona emanzini. Izazi ze-physiology zezitshalo azinasithakazelo kumandla kunoma yiluphi uhlelo oluthile lwamanzi, kodwa zinesithakazelo kakhulu ekuhambeni kwamanzi phakathi kwezinhlelo ezimbili. Ngakho-ke, ngokwezwi elisebenzayo, amandla amanzi umehluko kumandla angase abe khona phakathi kwesampula yamanzi ethile namanzi ahlanzekile (ekucindezelweni komoya kanye nokushisa okuzungezile). Amandla amanzi aboniswa uhlamvu lwesiGreki Ψ (psi) futhi abonakaliswa ngamayunithi okucindezela (ukucindezela kuyindlela yamandla) ebizwa ngokuthi ama-megapascals (MPa). Amandla amanzi ahlanzekile (Ψwpure H2O), ngokwencazelo elula, abizwa ngokuthi inani elingu-zero (yize amanzi ahlanzekile equkethe amandla amaningi angase abe khona, lawo mandla awanakwa). Ngakho-ke amanani amandla amanzi angase abe khona emanzini empandeni yesitshalo, isiqu, noma iqabunga abonakaliswa ngokuphathelene ne-Ψwpure H2O.

 Amandla amanzi ezixazululweni zezitshalo athonywa ukuhlushwa kwe-solute, ingcindezi, amandla adonsela phansi, kanye nezici ezibizwa ngokuthi imiphumela ye-matrix. Amandla amanzi angahlukaniswa abe izingxenye zawo ngazinye kusetshenziswa lesi sibalo esilandelayo:

 Ψsystem=Ψtotal=Ψs+Ψp+Ψg+Ψm
lapho i-Ψs, Ψp, Ψg, kanye ne-Ψm zibhekisela kumandla angase abe khona ... `Isistimu`ingabhekisela emandleni amanzi enhlabathi (Ψinhlabathi), amanzi ezimpande (Ψimpande), amanzi esiqu (Ψisiqu), amanzi eqabunga (Ψiqabunga) noma amanzi asemkhathini (Ψimvelo): noma yiluphi uhlelo lwamanzi olucatshangelwayo. Njengoba izingxenye ngazinye zishintsha, ziphakamisa noma zehlisa amandla amanzi aphelele esistimu. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, amanzi aya ngokulingana, esuka ohlelweni noma egunjini elinamandla amanzi aphezulu aye ohlelweni noma egunjini elinamandla amanzi aphansi. Lokhu kuletha umehluko emandleni amanzi phakathi kwezinhlelo ezimbili (ΔΨ) emuva ku-zero (ΔΨ = 0). Ngakho-ke, ukuze amanzi ahambe esitshalweni esuka enhlabathini aye emoyeni (inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-transpiration), i-Ψinhlabathi kumele ibe > Ψimpande > Ψisiqu > Ψiqabunga > Ψimvelo.

 Amanzi ahamba kuphela ngokuphendula ku-ΔΨ, hhayi ngokuphendula izingxenye ngazinye. Kodwa-ke, ngoba izingxenye ngazinye zithonya i-Ψisistimu iyonke, ngokulawula izingxenye ngazinye (ikakhulukazi Ψs), isitshalo singalawula ukuhamba kwamanzi

answer7: Amandla aqinile, ingcindezi, amandla adonsela phansi, kanye ne-matric

distractor7b: I-Photosynthesis, ukuphefumula, ingcindezi, kanye namandla adonsela phansi

chapterContent:
Amandla ancibilikayo (Ψs), abizwa nangokuthi amandla e-osmotic, ahlobene nokuhlushwa kwe-solute (nge-molarity). Lobo budlelwano bunikezwa yi-van t Hoff equation: Ψs = –MiRT; lapho i-M ingukuhlushwa kwe-molar kwe-solute, i iyi-van t Hoff factor (isilinganiso senani lezinhlayiya esixazululweni senani lamayunithi efomula ancibilikisiwe), i-R iyi-gas constant efanelekile, kanti i-T ingukushisa ngamadigri e-Kelvin. Amandla ancibilikayo ayi-negative esiseleni sesitshalo futhi ayi-zero emanzini ancibilikisiwe. Amanani ajwayelekile e-cytoplasm yeseli angama-–0.5 kuya ku-–1.0 MPa. Ama-solute anciphisa amandla amanzi (okuholela ku-Ψw engemihle) ngokudla amanye amandla akhona emanzini. Ama-molecule ancibilikayo angancibilika emanzini ngoba ama-molecule amanzi angabopha kuwo ngezibopho ze-hydrogen; i-molecule efana ne-hydrophobic efana ne-oyela, engakwazi ukubopha emanzini, ayikwazi ukungena esixazululweni. Amandla asezibophweni ze-hydrogen phakathi kwama-molecule ancibilikayo namanzi awasatholakali ukwenza umsebenzi ohlelweni ngoba aboshelwe esibophweni. Ngamanye amazwi, inani lamandla akhona atholakalayo liyancishiswa uma izinto ezincibilikayo zengezwa ohlelweni lwamanzi. Ngakho-ke, ama-Ψs ayancipha ngokwandisa ukuhlushwa kwe-solute. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-Ψs angenye yezingxenye ezine ze-Ψsystem noma i-Ψtotal, ukwehla kwama-Ψs kuzobangela ukwehla kwe-Ψtotal. Amandla amanzi angaphakathi eseli lesitshalo aphansi kakhulu kunamanzi ahlanzekile ngenxa yokuqukethwe okuphezulu kwe-solute kwe-cytoplasm (Isithombe 23.32). Ngenxa yalo mehluko emanzini anamandla amanzi azosuka enhlabathini aye kumaseli ezimpande zesitshalo ngenqubo ye-osmosis. Yingakho amandla ancibilikayo ngezinye izikhathi ebizwa ngokuthi amandla e-osmotic.

 Amaseli ezitshalo angalawula ama-Ψs ngokwe-metabolic (futhi ngokwengeziwe, i-Ψtotal) ngokungeza noma ukususa ama-molecule ancibilikayo. Ngakho-ke, izitshalo zilawula i-Ψtotal ngekhono lazo lokulawula i-metabolic phezu kwama-Ψs

question7: Izitshalo zingalawula kanjani amandla azo okusebenzisa amanzi aphelele (Ψtotal)?
answer7: Ngokufaka noma ukususa izixazululo ukushintsha amandla e-solute (Ψs)
question8: Ngokusho kwe-van t Hoff equation, iyiphi i-variable emele ukuhlushwa kwe-molar kwe-solute?
answer8: M
question9: Bheka uMfanekiso 23.32. Amandla amanzi aqondile asetshenziswa ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwethubhu ngokwandisa i-Ψp ukuze izinga lamanzi likhuphuke ohlangothini lwesokudla. Isibalo samandla amanzi yilesi: Ψsystem = Ψtotal = Ψs + Ψp + Ψg + Ψm lapho i-Ψs, Ψp, Ψg, kanye ne-Ψm zibhekisela kumandla ancibilikayo, ingcindezi, amandla adonsela phansi, kanye namandla e-matric, ngokulandelana. Ungalinganisa izinga lamanzi ohlangothini ngalunye lwethubhu ngokungeza i-solute?
answer9: Cha, izinga lamanzi alikwazi ukulinganiswa kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zepayipi ngokungeza i-solute yodwa. Ukwengeza i-solute kuzo zombili izinhlangothi kushintsha amandla e-solute ngendlela eqhuba ukunyakaza okwengeziwe kwamanzi e-osmotic kunokukhansela ingcindezi enhle esetshenzisiwe.
distractor9a: Yebo, izinga lamanzi lingalinganiswa ngokufaka i-solute ohlangothini lwesokudla lwepayipi ukuze amanzi ahambe aye ngakwesobunxele kuze kube yilapho amazinga amanzi elingana.
distractor9b: Yebo, izinga lamanzi lingalinganiswa ngokufaka i-solute ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwepayipi ukuze amanzi ahambe aye ngakwesobunxele kuze kube yilapho amazinga amanzi elingana.
distractor9c: Cha, izinga lamanzi alikwazi ukulinganiswa ngokungeza izinto ezincibilikisayo ngoba izinto ezincibilikisayo zihlala zidonswa phansi ngamandla adonsela phansi, ngaleyo ndlela zingavumeli amanzi alingane.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Uhlobo Lwezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.5 Ukuthuthwa Kwamanzi Nezinto Ezincibilikayo Ezitshalweni | Amandla Amanzi | Amandla Okucindezela
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants | Water Potential | Pressure Potential
chapterContent:
Amandla okucindezela (Ψp), abizwa nangokuthi amandla okucindezela, angaba mahle noma abe mabi (Isithombe 23.32). Ngenxa yokuthi ukucindezela kuyindlela yokubonisa amandla, lapho ukucindezela kuphakeme, amandla angaba maningi ohlelweni, futhi okuphambene nalokho. Ngakho-ke, i-Ψp (ukucindezela) okuhle kwandisa i-Ψtotal, kanti i-Ψp (ukucindezeleka) okubi kunciphisa i-Ψtotal. Ukucindezela okuhle ngaphakathi kwamaseli kuqukethwe udonga lweseli, okukhiqiza ukucindezela kwe-turgor. Amandla okucindezela ngokuvamile acishe abe yi-0.6–0.8 MPa, kodwa angafinyelela phezulu ku-1.5 MPa esitshalweni esiniselwa kahle. I-Ψp ye-1.5 MPa ilingana no-210 amakhilogremu nge-intshi yesikwele (1.5 MPa x 140 lb in-2 MPa-1 = 210 lb/in-2). Uma kuqhathaniswa, amathayi amaningi ezimoto agcinwa ekucindezelweni okungu-30–34 psi. Isibonelo somphumela wokucindezela kwe-turgor ukubuna kwamaqabunga nokubuyiselwa kwawo ngemva kokuba isitshalo siniselwe (Isithombe 23.33). Amanzi alahleka emaqabungeni ngokuvuvukala (esondela ku-Ψp = 0 MPa endaweni yokubuna) futhi abuyiselwe ngokumuncwa ngezimpande.

 Isitshalo singalawula i-Ψp ngekhono laso lokulawula i-Ψs nangenqubo ye-osmosis. Uma iseli lesitshalo landisa ukuhlushwa kwe-cytoplasmic solute, i-Ψs izoncipha, i-Ψtotal izoncipha, i-ΔΨ phakathi kweseli nezicubu ezizungezile izoncipha, amanzi azongena esitokisini nge-osmosis, kanti i-Ψp izokhula. I-Ψp nayo ingaphansi kokulawulwa kwesitshalo okungaqondile ngokuvulwa nokuvalwa kwe-stomata. Izimbobo zesisu zivumela amanzi ukuba aphele eqabungeni, kunciphisa i-Ψp kanye ne-Ψtotal yeqabu futhi kwandise i-ΔΨ phakathi kwamanzi eqabungeni kanye ne-petiole, ngaleyo ndlela kuvumela amanzi ukuba ageleze esuka eqabungeni aye eqabungeni.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Uhlobo Lwezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.5 Ukuthuthwa Kwamanzi Nezinto Ezincibilikayo Ezitshalweni | Amandla Amanzi | Amandla Okudonsela Phansi
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants | Water Potential | Gravity Potential
chapterContent: Amandla adonsela phansi (Ψg) ahlala ephansi aze abe yi-zero esitshalweni esingenakuphakama. Ahlala esusa noma edla amandla angase abe khona ohlelweni. Amandla adonsela phansi adonsela amanzi phansi aye enhlabathini, anciphise inani eliphelele lamandla angase abe khona emanzini esitshalweni (Ψtotal). Uma isitshalo side, ikholomu yamanzi iba yinde, futhi i-Ψg iba nethonya elikhulu. Esikalini samaseli nasezitshalweni ezimfushane, lo mphumela awubalulekile futhi awunakwa kalula. Kodwa-ke, ngaphezu kokuphakama kwesihlahla eside njenge-redwood enkulu yasogwini, ukudonsa kwamandla adonsela phansi kwe--0.1 MPa m-1 kufana nokumelana okwengeziwe kwe-10 MPa okumele kunqotshwe ukuze amanzi afinyelele amaqabunga ezihlahla ezinde kakhulu. Izitshalo azikwazi ukulawula i-Ψg

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Uhlobo Lwezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.5 Ukuthuthwa Kwamanzi Nezinto Ezincibilikayo Ezitshalweni | Amandla Amanzi | Amandla KaMatric
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants | Water Potential | Matric Potential
chapterContent: Amandla e-matric (Ψm) ahlala ephansi kuya ku-zero. Ohlelweni olomile, angaba ngaphansi njenge-–2 MPa embewini eyomile, futhi abe yi-zero ohlelweni olugcwele amanzi. Ukubopha amanzi kwi-matrix kuhlala kususa noma kudla amandla angase abe khona ohlelweni. I-Ψm ifana namandla e-solute ngoba ihilela ukubopha amandla ohlelweni olunamanzi ngokwakha izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwamanzi nenye ingxenye. Kodwa-ke, kumandla e-solute, ezinye izingxenye zingama-molecule e-solute ancibilikayo, aphilizayo, kanti ku-Ψm, ezinye izingxenye zingama-molecule angancibiliki, aphilizayo odongeni lweseli lesitshalo. Iseli ngalinye lesitshalo linodonga lweseli le-cellulosic futhi i-cellulose ezindongeni zeseli iphilizayo, ikhiqiza i-matrix yokunamathela kwamanzi: yingakho igama liyi-matric potential. I-Ψm inkulu kakhulu (i-negative) ezicutshini ezomile njengembewu noma inhlabathi ethinteke yisomiso. Kodwa-ke, iya ngokushesha ku-zero njengoba imbewu ithatha amanzi noma inhlabathi imanzi. I-Ψm ayikwazi ukuphathwa yisitshalo futhi ivame ukunganakwa ezimpandeni eziniselwe kahle, eziqwini, nasemaqabungeni

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.5 Ukuthuthwa Kwamanzi Nezinto Ezincibilikayo Ezitshalweni | Ukuhamba Kwamanzi Namaminerali Ku-Xylem
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants | Movement of Water and Minerals in the Xylem
chapterContent:
Izincibilikisi, ingcindezi, amandla adonsela phansi, kanye namandla e-matric konke kubalulekile ekuthuthweni kwamanzi ezitshalweni. Amanzi asuka endaweni enamandla aphezulu amanzi (amandla aphezulu angenawo ama-Gibbs) aye endaweni enamandla aphansi amanzi. Amandla angenawo ama-Gibbs amandla ahlotshaniswa nokusabela kwamakhemikhali okungasetshenziswa ukwenza umsebenzi. Lokhu kuvezwa njengo-ΔΨ.

 Ukuphefumulela ukulahleka kwamanzi esitshalweni ngokuhwamuka ebusweni beqabunga. Kungumshayeli oyinhloko wokunyakaza kwamanzi ku-xylem. Ukuphefumulela kubangelwa ukuhwamuka kwamanzi esibonakalayo seqabunga-sendawo; kudala ingcindezi engemihle (ukucindezelwa) okulingana no-2 MPa ebusweni beqabunga. Leli nani liyahlukahluka kakhulu kuye ngokuntuleka kwengcindezi yomhwamuko, okungaba yinto encane ekumswakama ophezulu (RH) kanye nokuba mkhulu ku-RH ephansi. Amanzi avela ezimpandeni adonswa yilokhu kucindezelwa. Ebusuku, lapho i-stomata ivaleka futhi ukuvuvukala kuyeka, amanzi abanjwa esiqwini naseqabungeni ngokunamathela kwamanzi ezindongeni zamaseli zemithambo ye-xylem kanye nama-tracheids, kanye nokuhlangana kwama-molecule amanzi komunye nomunye. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-cohesion-tension theory yokwenyuka kwe-sap.

 Ngaphakathi kweqabunga ezingeni lamaseli, amanzi ebusweni bamaseli e-mesophyll agcwalisa ama-microfibrils e-cellulose odongeni lweseli oluyinhloko. Iqabunga liqukethe izikhala eziningi zomoya ezinkulu phakathi kwamaseli ukuze kushintshwe umoya-mpilo ne-carbon dioxide, okudingekayo kwi-photosynthesis. Udonga lwamaseli amanzi luvezwa kulesi sikhala somoya wangaphakathi weqabunga, futhi amanzi ebusweni bamaseli ayahwamuka aye ezikhaleni zomoya, kunciphisa ifilimu encane ebusweni bamaseli e-mesophyll. Lokhu kwehla kudala ukucindezeleka okukhulu emanzini kumaseli e-mesophyll (Isithombe 23.34), ngaleyo ndlela kwandisa ukudonsa kwamanzi ezitsheni ze-xylem. Imithambo ye-xylem kanye nama-tracheids ahlelwe ngendlela efanele ukuze abhekane nezinguquko ezinkulu ekucindezelweni. Amasongo asezitsheni agcina isimo sawo esiyindilinga, njengoba nje amasongo asepayipini lokuhlanza i-vacuum egcina ipayipi livulekile ngenkathi lingaphansi kwengcindezi. Ukubhoboka okuncane phakathi kwezinto ezisezitsheni kunciphisa inani nosayizi wama-bubble egesi angakheka ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-cavitation. Ukwakheka kwama-bubble egesi ku-xylem kuphazamisa ukugeleza okuqhubekayo kwamanzi kusukela esisekelweni kuya phezulu kwesitshalo, okubangela ukuqhekeka okubizwa ngokuthi i-embolism ekugelezeni kwe-xylem sap. Uma umuthi umude, kulapho amandla okucindezela adingeka khona ukudonsa amanzi, kanye nemicimbi eminingi ye-cavitation. Ezihlahleni ezinkulu, ama-embolism aphumayo angavimba izitsha ze-xylem, okwenza zingasebenzi.

 Ukuphefumulela—ukulahlekelwa umhwamuko wamanzi emkhathini nge-stomata—kuyinqubo engenzi lutho, okusho ukuthi amandla e-metabolic ngesimo se-ATP awadingeki ukuze kuhambe amanzi. Ukuphefumulela okushayela amandla umehluko wamandla phakathi kwamanzi enhlabathini namanzi asemkhathini. Kodwa-ke, ukuphefumulela kulawulwa ngokuqinile

chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.5 Transport of Water and Solutes in Plants | Movement of Water and Minerals in the Xylem | Control of Transpiration
chapterContent:
Umkhathi lapho iqabunga livezwa khona uqhuba ukuvuvukala, kodwa futhi ubangela ukulahleka kwamanzi amaningi esitshalweni. Amaphesenti angama-90 amanzi athathwa yizimpande angalahleka ngokuvuvukala.

 Amaqabunga ambozwe yi-cuticle efana ne-wax ebusweni bangaphandle evimbela ukulahleka kwamanzi. Ngakho-ke, ukulawulwa kokuvuvukala kufezwa ngokuyinhloko ngokuvula nokuvala i-stomata ebusweni beqabunga. Ama-Stomata azungezwe amaseli amabili akhethekile abizwa ngokuthi ama-guard cell, avuleka futhi avalwe ngenxa yezimpawu zemvelo ezifana nokukhanya okukhulu kanye nekhwalithi, isimo samanzi eqabunga, kanye nokugcwala kwe-carbon dioxide. Ama-Stomata kumele avuleke ukuze avumele umoya oqukethe i-carbon dioxide kanye ne-oxygen ukuthi usakazeke eqabungeni ukuze kwenziwe i-photosynthesis nokuphefumula. Nokho, lapho ama-stomata evulekile, umhwamuko wamanzi ulahleka endaweni yangaphandle, okwandisa izinga lokuvuvukala. Ngakho-ke, izitshalo kumele zilondoloze ibhalansi phakathi kwe-photosynthesis ephumelelayo nokulahleka kwamanzi.

 Izitshalo ziye zashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ukuze zivumelane nendawo yazo yasendaweni futhi zinciphise ukuvuvukala (Isithombe 23.35). Izitshalo zasehlane (ama-xerophyte) kanye nezitshalo ezikhula kwezinye izitshalo (ama-epiphyte) zinokufinyelela okulinganiselwe emanzini. Izitshalo ezinjalo zivame ukuba ne-cuticle ejiyile kakhulu efana ne-wax kunezo ezikhula ezindaweni ezilinganiselwe, ezinamanzi amaningi (ama-mesophyte). Izitshalo zasemanzini (ama-hydrophyte) nazo zinesethi yazo yokuguquguquka kwamaqabunga okwakheka komzimba kanye nokwakheka kwawo.

 Ama-Xerophyte nama-epiphyte avame ukuba nesembozo esijiyile sama-trichomes noma ama-stomata acwiliswe ngaphansi kobuso beqabunga. Ama-Trichomes angamaseli e-epidermal akhethekile afana nezinwele akhipha amafutha nezinto. Lokhu kuguquguquka kuvimbela ukuhamba komoya embotsheni yesisu futhi kunciphise ukujuluka. Izingqimba eziningi ze-epidermal nazo zivame ukutholakala kulezi zinhlobo zezitshalo

chapterContent:
Izitshalo zidinga umthombo wamandla ukuze zikhule. Embewu nakuma-bulb, ukudla kugcinwa kuma-polymer (njengesitashi) aguqulwa yizinqubo ze-metabolic zibe yi-sucrose yezitshalo ezisanda kukhula. Uma amahlumela aluhlaza namaqabunga esekhulile, izitshalo ziyakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla kwazo ngokwenza i-photosynthesizing. Imikhiqizo ye-photosynthesis ibizwa ngokuthi i-photosynthates, evame ukuba ngesimo soshukela olula njenge-sucrose.

 Izakhiwo ezikhiqiza i-photosynthates zesitshalo esikhulayo zibizwa ngokuthi imithombo. Ushukela okhiqizwa emithonjeni, njengamaqabunga, udinga ukulethwa ezingxenyeni ezikhulayo zesitshalo nge-phloem enqubweni ebizwa ngokuthi i-translocation. Amaphuzu okulethwa kukashukela, njengezimpande, amahlumela amancane, kanye nembewu ekhulayo, abizwa ngokuthi ama-sink. Imbewu, izilimo eziyizigaxa, nama-bulb kungaba umthombo noma isinki, kuye ngesigaba sokukhula kwesitshalo kanye nesizini.

 Imikhiqizo evela emthonjeni ivame ukuthuthelwa kusinki esiseduze nge-phloem. Isibonelo, amaqabunga aphezulu kakhulu azothumela ama-photosynthate phezulu esicongweni sehlumela elikhulayo, kanti amaqabunga aphansi azoqondisa ama-photosynthate phansi ezimpandeni. Amaqabunga aphakathi azothumela imikhiqizo kuzo zombili izinhlangothi, ngokungafani nokugeleza kwe-xylem, okuhlala kuqondiswa yi-unidirectional (inhlabathi kuya eqabungeni kuya emoyeni). Iphethini yokugeleza kwe-photosynthate iyashintsha njengoba isitshalo sikhula futhi sikhula. Ama-photosynthate aqondiswa ngokuyinhloko ezimpandeni kusenesikhathi, emahlumela nasemaqabungeni ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezitshalo, kanye nasembewini nasezithelo ngesikhathi sokukhula kokuzala. Aqondiswa futhi ezitshalweni ukuze zigcinwe.

Ama-photosynthate, njenge-sucrose, akhiqizwa kumaseli e-mesophyll amaqabunga e-photosynthesizing. Ukusuka lapho adluliselwa nge-phloem aye lapho asetshenziswa noma agcinwa khona. Amaseli e-Mesophyll axhunywe yiziteshi ze-cytoplasmic ezibizwa ngokuthi i-plasmodesmata. Ama-photosynthate ahamba ngalezi ziteshi ukuze afinyelele izakhi ze-phloem sieve-tube (ama-STE) ezinqwabeni zemithambo yegazi. Kusukela kumaseli e-mesophyll, ama-photosynthate afakwa kuma-phloem STE. I-sucrose ithuthwa ngenkuthalo ngokumelene ne-concentration gradient yayo (inqubo edinga i-ATP) kumaseli e-phloem kusetshenziswa amandla e-electrochemical e-proton gradient. Lokhu kuhlanganiswe nokumuncwa kwe-sucrose ngeprotheni ethwalayo ebizwa ngokuthi i-sucrose-H+ symporter.

 Ama-Phloem STE anokuqukethwe kwe-cytoplasmic okuncishisiwe, futhi axhunywe ngepuleti lesivingo elinama-pores avumela ukugeleza okukhulu okuqhutshwa yingcindezi, noma ukuthuthwa, kwe-phloem sap. Amaseli ahambisanayo ahlotshaniswa nama-STE. Zisiza ngemisebenzi ye-metabolic futhi zikhiqize amandla e-STE (Isithombe 23.36).

 Uma seziku-phloem, ama-photosynthate adluliselwa kusinki esiseduze. I-Phloem sap iyisisombululo samanzi esiqukethe ushukela ofinyelela kumaphesenti angu-30, amaminerali, ama-amino acid, kanye nabalawuli bokukhula kwezitshalo. Iphesenti eliphezulu likashukela linciphisa ama-Ψs, okunciphisa amandla amanzi aphelele futhi kubangele amanzi ukuba ahambe nge-osmosis esuka ku-xylem eseduze aye kumashubhu e-phloem, ngaleyo ndlela kwandiswe ingcindezi. Lokhu kwanda kwamandla amanzi aphelele kubangela ukugeleza okukhulu kwe-phloem kusuka emthonjeni kuya kusinki (Isithombe 23.37). Ukuhlushwa kwe-sucrose kumaseli esinki kuphansi kunakuma-phloem STE ngoba i-sucrose yesinki ishintshiwe ukuze ikhule, noma iguqulwe ibe yisitashi sokugcina noma amanye ama-polymer, njenge-cellulose, ukuze kube nokuqina kwesakhiwo. Ukukhulula ekupheleleni kwesinki seshubhu le-phloem kwenzeka ngokusabalala noma ukuthuthwa okusebenzayo kwama-molecule e-sucrose kusuka endaweni yokuhlushwa okuphezulu kuya kwenye yokuhlushwa okuphansi. Amanzi ayasabalala kusuka ku-phloem nge-osmosis bese edluliselwa noma aphinde asetshenziswe nge-xylem abuyele ku-phloem sap.
