Kungani ezinye izitshalo eziqhakaza ziqhakaza entwasahlobo, kanti ezinye ziqhakaza ehlobo noma ekwindla? Kungani iziqu zezitshalo zikhula phezulu futhi zigobe ziye ekukhanyeni, kuyilapho izimpande zikhula ziye phansi? Kungani amaqabunga ezitshalo ezibolayo ezindaweni ezisenyakatho ephenduka imibala ekwindla bese ekugcineni ewa, kuyilapho izitshalo ezihlala ziluhlaza zigcina izinaliti zazo unyaka wonke? Kuyiqiniso yini ukuthi ukufaka i-avocado engavuthiwe esikhwameni sephepha kuzosheshisa inqubo yokuvuthwa? Ingabe isu elifanayo lingasebenza kubhanana?

 Njengezinye izinto eziningi eziphilayo, izitshalo zinekhono lokubona nokuphendula ekushintsheni kwemvelo; leli khono liyindlela yokuguquguquka ethandwa ukukhethwa kwemvelo. Izitshalo eziqhakaza zisabela ekukhanyeni, amandla adonsela phansi, ukutheleleka ngamagciwane, isomiso, kanye, njengase-Venus flytrap, ukuthinta. Izilwane zinezinhlelo ezimbili ezingathembela kuzo ukuthola nokusabela ezivuselelweni: izinhlelo zezinzwa neze-endocrine. Nokho, izitshalo zinezindlela zokulawula amakhemikhali kuphela ezinazo. Ngaphezu kwama-phytochrome, izitshalo zathuthukisa ama-hormone azivumela ukuthi aphendule ezinguqukweni zemvelo. Njengama-hormone ezilwane, ama-hormone ezitshalo angama-molecule okubonisa amakhemikhali aqala impendulo yeselula ngendlela yokudlulisela isignali.

 Nakuba kungadingeki ukuthi ubambe ngekhanda uhlu lwezingubo zama-hormone ezitshalo kanye nemisebenzi yawo, kufanele uqonde indlela eyisisekelo yokuthi aqala kanjani impendulo. Izibonelo esizofunda ngazo kulesi sahluko zifaka phakathi ama-auxin, abangela ukuthi iziqu zezitshalo zikhule futhi zigobe ziye ekukhanyeni, kanye nama-gibberellin, akhuthaza ukukhula kwamaseli futhi aphule ukungalali kwembewu. Izitshalo zikhiqiza namanye amakhemikhali ukuvikela ezifweni ezibangelwa yi-biotic, okuhlanganisa ukhula lwezitshalo kanye ne-parasitism. Iqiniso lokuthi izitshalo zikhiqiza amakhemikhali akufanele limangaze; imboni yethu yezokwelapha incike kulezi zinto. Isibonelo, izinhlobo zesitshalo se-foxglove zikhiqiza i-digitalis, umuthi wenhliziyo onamandla, kanti i-opium evela ku-poppy ingumthombo wezidakamizwa eziningi.

 Izilwane zingasabela ezicini zemvelo ngokuthuthela endaweni entsha. Izitshalo, nokho, zigxilile endaweni yazo futhi kumele ziphendule ezicini zemvelo ezizungezile. Izitshalo zinezinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi zokubona nokusabela ekukhanyeni, amandla adonsela phansi, izinga lokushisa, kanye nokuthintana ngokomzimba. Ama-receptor azwa izici zemvelo futhi adlulisela ulwazi ezinhlelweni ezisebenzayo—ngokuvamile ngokusebenzisa izithunywa zamakhemikhali eziphakathi nendawo—ukuze alethe izimpendulo zezitshalo.

Izitshalo zinezindlela eziningi ezisetshenziswa kakhulu ekukhanyeni ezidlula kakhulu ikhono lazo lokwenza i-photosynthesis ushukela onesisindo esincane sama-molecule zisebenzisa i-carbon dioxide, ukukhanya, namanzi kuphela. I-Photomorphogenesis ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa kwezitshalo ekuphenduleni ukukhanya. Ivumela izitshalo ukuthi zisebenzise kahle ukukhanya nendawo. I-Photoperiodism yikhono lokusebenzisa ukukhanya ukulandelela isikhathi. Izitshalo zingabona isikhathi sosuku nesikhathi sonyaka ngokuzwa nokusebenzisa amaza ahlukahlukene okukhanya kwelanga. I-Phototropism iyimpendulo eqondisayo evumela izitshalo ukuthi zikhule ziye ekukhanyeni, noma ngisho kude nokukhanya.

 Ukuzwa ukukhanya endaweni ezungezile kubalulekile ezitshalweni; kungabaluleka ekuncintisaneni nasekusindeni. Impendulo yezitshalo ekukhanyeni iqondiswa ama-photoreceptor ahlukene, akhiwe yiphrotheni ehlanganiswe ndawonye ne-pigment emunca ukukhanya ebizwa ngokuthi i-chromophore. Zombili lezi zibizwa ngokuthi i-chromoprotein.

 Izindawo ezibomvu/ezibomvu kakhulu neziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ze-spectrum yokukhanya okubonakalayo ziqala ukuthuthukiswa kwesakhiwo ezitshalweni. Ama-photoreceptor anezinzwa amunca ukukhanya kulezi zindawo ezithile ze-spectrum yokukhanya okubonakalayo ngenxa yekhwalithi yokukhanya okutholakala ku-spectrum yokukhanya kwasemini. Ezindaweni zokuhlala zomhlaba, ukumuncwa kokukhanya yi-chlorophyll kufinyelela phezulu ezindaweni eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nezibomvu ze-spectrum. Njengoba ukukhanya kuhlunga nge-canopy kanye namaza okukhanya aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nokubomvu emuncwa, i-spectrum ishintshela ekugcineni okubomvu kakhulu, ishintshe umphakathi wezitshalo kulezo zitshalo ukuze zivumelane kangcono nokusabela ekukhanyeni okubomvu kakhulu. Ama-receptor okukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka avumela izitshalo ukuthi zilinganise isiqondiso kanye nobuningi bokukhanya kwelanga, okucebile ngokukhishwa okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kuya koluhlaza. Amanzi amunca ukukhanya okubomvu, okwenza ukutholakala kokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kubalulekile ezitshalweni zasemanzini nasezitshalweni zasemanzini.

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo Nezimpendulo | Izimpendulo Zezitshalo Ekukhanyeni | Uhlelo Lwe-Phytochrome kanye Nempendulo Ebomvu/Ebomvu Kakhulu
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Plant Responses to Light | The Phytochrome System and the Red/Far-Red Response
chapterContent:
Ama-phytochrome awumndeni wama-chromoprotein ane-chromophore ye-tetrapyrrole eqondile, efana neqembu lekhanda le-chlorophyll elibamba ukukhanya le-tetrapyrrole eliyindandatho. Ama-phytochrome anezinhlobo ezimbili eziguquguqukayo: i-Pr ne-Pfr. I-Pr imunca ukukhanya okubomvu (~667 nm) futhi iguqulwa ngokushesha ibe yi-Pfr. I-Pfr imunca ukukhanya okubomvu kakhulu (~730 nm) futhi iguqulwa ngokushesha ibe yi-Pr. Ukumunca ukukhanya okubomvu noma okubomvu kakhulu kubangela ushintsho olukhulu esimweni se-chromophore, okushintsha ukwakheka kanye nomsebenzi weprotheyini ye-phytochrome eboshwe kuyo. I-Pfr iwuhlobo olusebenzayo ngokomzimba lweprotheyini; ngakho-ke, ukuchayeka ekukhanyeni okubomvu kuveza umsebenzi womzimba. Ukuchayeka ekukhanyeni okubomvu kakhulu kuvimbela umsebenzi we-phytochrome. Ndawonye, lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zimelela uhlelo lwe-phytochrome (Isithombe 23.38).

 Uhlelo lwe-phytochrome lusebenza njengesishintshi sokukhanya sebhayoloji. Iqapha izinga, ubukhali, ubude, kanye nombala wokukhanya kwemvelo. Umphumela wokukhanya okubomvu uguqulwa ngokukhanya okubomvu okukhanyayo ngokushesha kusampula, okuguqula i-chromoprotein ibe yifomu le-Pr elingasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Pfr ingabuyela kancane kancane ku-Pr ebumnyameni, noma ihlukane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kuzo zonke izimo, impendulo yomzimba ebangelwa ukukhanya okubomvu iyaguqulwa. Uhlobo olusebenzayo lwe-phytochrome (Pfr) lungavuselela ngqo amanye ama-molecule ku-cytoplasm, noma lungathunyelwa kuyi-nucleus, lapho luvuselela khona ngqo noma lucindezele ukubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ezithile.

 Uma uhlelo lwe-phytochrome selushintshile, izitshalo zalushintsha ukuze lufeze izidingo ezahlukahlukene. Ukukhanya kwelanga okugcwele okungahlungiwe, okugcwele kuqukethe ukukhanya okubomvu okuningi kunokukhanya okubomvu okukude. Ngenxa yokuthi i-chlorophyll imunca kakhulu esifundeni esibomvu se-spectrum ebonakalayo, kodwa hhayi esifundeni esibomvu okukude, noma yisiphi isitshalo esisemthunzini wesinye isitshalo phansi kwehlathi sizovezwa ekukhanyeni okubomvu okuphelelwe yisikhathi, okucebile ngokubomvu okude. Ukwanda kokukhanya okubomvu kakhulu kuguqula i-phytochrome emaqabungeni anombala okhanyayo kube yifomu le-Pr (elingasebenzi), okunciphisa ukukhula. Izindawo eziseduze ezingenamthunzi (noma ngisho nezingenamthunzi kakhulu) phansi kwehlathi zinokukhanya okubomvu okwengeziwe; amaqabunga abonakala kulezi zindawo azwa ukukhanya okubomvu, okuvuselela ifomu le-Pfr futhi kubangele ukukhula. Ngamafuphi, amahlumela ezitshalo asebenzisa uhlelo lwe-phytochrome ukuze akhule kude nomthunzi futhi abheke ekukhanyeni. Ngenxa yokuthi ukuncintisana kokukhanya kukhulu kakhulu emphakathini wezitshalo eziminyene, izinzuzo zokuziphendukela kwemvelo zohlelo lwe-phytochrome zisobala.

 Embewu, uhlelo lwe-phytochrome alusetshenziswa ukunquma isiqondiso kanye nekhwalithi yokukhanya (okunombala okhanyayo uma kuqhathaniswa nokunganombala). Esikhundleni salokho, ingabe lusetshenziswa nje ukunquma ukuthi kukhona yini ukukhanya nhlobo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ezinhlotsheni ezinembewu encane kakhulu, njenge-lettuce. Ngenxa yobukhulu bazo, imbewu ye-lettuce inokudla okuncane okugciniwe. Izithombo zazo azikwazi ukukhula isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba ziphelelwe uphethiloli. Uma zihluma ngisho nesentimitha ngaphansi komhlabathi, isithombo ngeke sifike elangeni futhi sizofa. Ebumnyameni, i-phytochrome ikwisimo se-Pr (ifomu elingasebenzi) futhi imbewu ngeke ikhule; izokhula kuphela uma ivezwa ekukhanyeni ebusweni bomhlabathi. Lapho ivezwa ekukhanyeni, i-Pr iguqulwa ibe yi-Pfr bese kuqhubeka ukuhluma.

 Izitshalo zisebenzisa nohlelo lwe-phytochrome ukuzwa ushintsho lwesizini. I-Photoperiodism iyimpendulo yezinto eziphilayo esikhathini nasebudeni bemini nobusuku. Ilawula ukuqhakaza, ukuvela kwamahlumela asebusika, kanye nokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukutholwa kwezinguquko zesizini kubalulekile ekusindeni kwesitshalo. Nakuba izinga lokushisa kanye nokukhanya kuthonya ukukhula kwesitshalo, akuzona izinkomba ezithembekile zesizini ngoba zingahluka kusukela onyakeni kuya kolandelayo. Ubude bosuku buyisibonakaliso esingcono sesikhathi sonyaka.

 Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, ukukhanya kwelanga okungahlungiwe kucebile ngokukhanya okubomvu kodwa akunawo ukukhanya okubomvu kakhulu. Ngakho-ke, ekuntweleni kokusa, wonke ama-molecule e-phytochrome eqabungeni aguquka ngokushesha abe yisimo se-Pfr esisebenzayo, futhi ahlale kuleso simo kuze kube yilapho kushona ilanga. Ebumnyameni, isimo se-Pfr sithatha amahora ukubuyela kancane kancane esimweni se-Pr. Uma ubusuku bude (njengasebusika), lonke uhlobo lwe-Pfr luyabuya. Uma ubusuku bufushane (njengasehlobo), inani elikhulu le-Pfr lingasala ekuphumeni kwelanga. Ngokubona isilinganiso se-Pr/Pfr ekuntweleni kokusa, isitshalo singanquma ubude bomjikelezo wosuku/ubusuku. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaqabunga agcina lolo lwazi izinsuku eziningana, okuvumela ukuqhathanisa phakathi kobude bobusuku bangaphambilini nobusuku obuningana obandulele. Ubusuku obufushane bubonisa isikhathi sasentwasahlobo esitshalweni; lapho ubusuku buba bude, ikwindla iyasondela. Lolu lwazi, kanye nokuzwa izinga lokushisa kanye nokutholakala kwamanzi, kuvumela izitshalo ukuthi zinqume isikhathi sonyaka futhi zilungise imizimba yazo ngokufanele. Izitshalo zosuku olufushane (ubusuku obude) zisebenzisa lolu lwazi ukuqhakaza ngasekupheleni kwehlobo nasekuqaleni kwekwindla, lapho ubusuku budlula ubude obubalulekile (ngokuvamile amahora ayisishiyagalombili noma ngaphansi). Izitshalo zosuku olude (ubusuku obufushane) ziqhakaza entwasahlobo, lapho ubumnyama bungaphansi kobude obubalulekile (ngokuvamile amahora ayisishiyagalombili kuya kwangu-15). Akuzona zonke izitshalo ezisebenzisa uhlelo lwe-phytochrome ngale ndlela. Ukuqhakaza ezitshalweni ezingathathi hlangothi emini akulawulwa ubude bosuku

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zezitshalo Ekukhanyeni | Izimpendulo Zokukhanya Okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Plant Responses to Light | The Blue Light Responses
chapterContent:
I-Phototropism—ukugoba kwesitshalo ngqo emthonjeni wokukhanya noma kude—kuyimpendulo kumaza okukhanya aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. I-phototropism enhle ukukhula kuya emthonjeni wokukhanya (Isithombe 23.39), kuyilapho i-phototropism engemihle (ebizwa nangokuthi i-skototropism) ukukhula kude nokukhanya.

 Ama-phototropin aqanjwe ngokufanele angama-receptor asekelwe kumaprotheni abhekene nokulawula impendulo ye-phototropic. Njengazo zonke ama-photoreceptor ezitshalo, ama-phototropin aqukethe ingxenye yephrotheni kanye nengxenye emunca ukukhanya, ebizwa ngokuthi i-chromophore. Kuma-phototropin, i-chromophore iyi-molecule eboshwe ndawonye ye-flavin; ngakho-ke, ama-phototropin angaphansi kwesigaba samaprotheni abizwa ngokuthi ama-flavoprotein.

 Ezinye izimpendulo ngaphansi kokulawulwa kwama-phototropin ukuvula nokuvala amaqabunga, ukunyakaza kwe-chloroplast, kanye nokuvulwa kwe-stomata. Kodwa-ke, kuzo zonke izimpendulo ezilawulwa ama-phototropin, i-phototropism ifundwe isikhathi eside futhi iyona eqondakala kangcono.

 Encwadini yabo ka-1880 ethi The Power of Movements in Plants, uCharles Darwin nendodana yakhe uFrancis baqale bachaza i-phototropism njengokugoba kwezithombo ziye ekukhanyeni. UDarwin waphawula ukuthi ukukhanya kwakubonakala ngesihloko sesitshalo (i-apical meristem), kodwa ukuthi impendulo (ukugoba) yenzeka engxenyeni ehlukile yesitshalo. Baphetha ngokuthi isignali kwakufanele ihambe isuka ku-apical meristem iye phansi kwesitshalo.

 Ngo-1913, uPeter Boysen-Jensen wabonisa ukuthi isignali yamakhemikhali ekhiqizwe esicongweni sesitshalo yayibangela ukugoba phansi. Wasika isihloko sesithombo, wamboza ingxenye esikiwe ngengqimba ye-gelatin, wabe esefaka isihloko esikhundleni saso. Isithombo sagoba saya ekukhanyeni lapho sikhanyiswa. Kodwa-ke, lapho kufakwa ama-mica flakes angangeni phakathi kwesihloko nesisekelo esinqunyiwe, isithombo asigobanga. Ukulungiswa kokuhlolwa kwabonisa ukuthi isignali yayihamba ohlangothini olunomthunzi lwesithombo. Lapho ipuleti le-mica lifakwa ohlangothini olukhanyisiwe, isitshalo sagoba saya ekukhanyeni. Ngakho-ke, isignali yamakhemikhali yayiyisikhuthazi sokukhula ngoba impendulo ye-phototropic yayihilela ukunwebeka kwamaseli ngokushesha ohlangothini olunomthunzi kunasohlangothini olukhanyisiwe. Manje sesiyazi ukuthi njengoba ukukhanya kudlula esiqwini sesitshalo, kuyaphazanyiswa futhi kukhiqize ukusebenza kwe-phototropin kulo lonke isiqu. Ukusebenza okuningi kwenzeka ohlangothini olukhanyisiwe, okubangela ukuthi i-plant hormone indole acetic acid (IAA) iqoqeke ohlangothini olunomthunzi. Amaseli esiqu ayanda ngaphansi kwethonya le-IAA.

 Ama-Cryptochrome ayisigaba sama-photoreceptors adonsa ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka aqukethe ne-chromophore esekelwe ku-flavin. Ama-Cryptochrome abeka izitshalo umjikelezo womsebenzi wamahora angama-24, futhi aziwa njenge-rhythem yawo ye-circadian, esebenzisa izinkomba zokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Kunobufakazi bokuthi ama-cryptochrome asebenza ndawonye nama-phototropin ukuze aqondise impendulo ye-phototropic.

chapterContent:
Igama elithi horticulturist” livela emagameni esiLatini asho ingadi (hortus) kanye namasiko (cultura). Lo msebenzi uguqulwe kakhulu yintuthuko eyenziwe ekuqondeni izimpendulo zezitshalo ezithinta izinto ezithinta imvelo. Abalimi bezitshalo, izithelo, imifino, nezimbali babevinjelwe ngaphambilini ngokuthatha isikhathi sokuhlwanyela nokuvuna kwabo ngokwesizini. Manje, abalimi bezitshalo bangalawula izitshalo ukuze bandise ukukhiqizwa kwamaqabunga, izimbali, noma izithelo ngokuqonda ukuthi izici zemvelo zithinta kanjani ukukhula kwezitshalo nokukhula kwazo.

 Ukuphathwa kwe-greenhouse kuyisici esibalulekile semfundo yabalimi bezitshalo. Ukuze kwandiswe ubusuku, izitshalo zimbozwa ngendwangu yomthunzi omnyama. Izitshalo zosuku olude zikhanyiswe ngokukhanya okubomvu ebusika ukukhuthaza ukuqhakaza kwasekuqaleni. Isibonelo, ukukhanya okukhanyayo (okumhlophe okupholile) okuphezulu ngamaza aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kukhuthaza ukukhula kwamaqabunga futhi kuhle kakhulu ekuqaleni kwezithombo. Izibani ze-Incandescent (ama-bulb ajwayelekile) zicebile ngokukhanya okubomvu, futhi zikhuthaza ukuqhakaza kwezinye izitshalo. Isikhathi sokuvuthwa kwezithelo singandiswa noma sibambezeleke ngokusebenzisa ama-hormone ezitshalo. Muva nje, kwenziwe intuthuko enkulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlobo zezitshalo ezifanele izimo zezulu ezahlukene futhi ezimelana nazo. ezinambuzaneni nasekulimaleni kwezokuthutha. Kokubili isivuno sezitshalo kanye nekhwalithi kuye kwanda ngenxa yokusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kolwazi lwezimpendulo zezitshalo ezishukunyiswayo zangaphandle kanye nama-hormone.

 Abalimi bezitshalo bathola imisebenzi emalabhorethri azimele kanye nawohulumeni, ezindaweni zokugcina izithombo, ezingadini zezitshalo, kanye nasemasimini okukhiqiza noma ocwaningo. Bathuthukisa izitshalo ngokusebenzisa ulwazi lwabo lwezakhi zofuzo kanye ne-physiology yezitshalo. Ukuze balungiselele umsebenzi wezolimo, abafundi bathatha amakilasi ezitshalo, i-physiology yezitshalo, i-pathology yezitshalo, ukuklama indawo, kanye nokuzalanisa izitshalo. Ukuze bagcwalise lezi zifundo zendabuko, abafundi bezolimo zezitshalo banezela izifundo kwezomnotho, ibhizinisi, isayensi yamakhompyutha, kanye nokuxhumana.
question1: Ukuqonda okuthuthukisiwe kwezimpendulo zezitshalo ezivuselelweni zemvelo kuye kwazuzisa kanjani ukulima kwezitshalo?
answer1: Ivumela abalimi ukuthi balawule ukukhula kwezitshalo, ukuqhakaza kwezimbali kanye nokukhiqizwa kwezithelo
distractor1c: Ivumela izitshalo ukuthi zikhule ngaphandle kokukhanya kwelanga
question2: Kungani izitshalo ze-greenhouse ngezinye izikhathi zimbozwa ngendwangu emnyama evala umthunzi?
question3: Kungani izitshalo ezihlala usuku lonke zivezwa ekukhanyeni okubomvu ebusika?
question4: Yiluphi uhlobo lokukhanya okwenziwe oluwusizo kakhulu ekuqaliseni izithombo?
answer4: Ukukhanya okukhanyayo (okumhlophe okupholile) okucebile ngamaza aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
question5: Izibani ezikhanyayo ezigcwele ukukhanya okubomvu zinamuphi umphumela ezitshalweni eziningi?
answer5: Zikhuthaza ukuqhakaza kwezimbali
question6: Abalimi bezitshalo bangayishintsha kanjani isikhathi sokuvuthwa kwezithelo?
answer6: Ngokusebenzisa ama-hormone ezitshalo
question7: Kungani abalimi bezitshalo bethuthukisa izinhlobo ezintsha zezitshalo?
answer7: Ukuthuthukisa ukuzivumelanisa nezimo zezulu ezahlukene nokwandisa ukumelana nezinambuzane kanye nomonakalo wokuthutha
question8: Yiziphi izifundo, ngaphezu kwesayensi yezitshalo, eziwusizo emsebenzini wokulima?
answer8: Ezomnotho, ibhizinisi, isayensi yamakhompyutha, kanye nokuxhumana

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zezitshalo Kumandla Adonsela Phansi
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Plant Responses to Gravity
chapterContent:
Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zimila ekukhanyeni noma ebumnyameni obukhulu, amahlumela avame ukuhluma emhlabathini, futhi izimpande zikhula ziye phansi emhlabathini. Isitshalo esibekwe eceleni ebumnyameni sizothumela amahlumela phezulu uma sinikezwa isikhathi esanele. I-Gravitropism iqinisekisa ukuthi izimpande zikhula emhlabathini nokuthi amahlumela akhula aye elangeni. Ukukhula kwesiqu sehlumela phezulu kubizwa ngokuthi i-gravitropism engemihle, kanti ukukhula kwezimpande phansi kubizwa ngokuthi i-gravitropism enhle.

 Ama-Amyloplast (aziwa nangokuthi ama-statoliths) angama-plastid akhethekile aqukethe ama-starch granules futhi ahlala phansi ngenxa yamandla adonsela phansi. Ama-Amyloplast atholakala kumahlumela nasemaseli akhethekile esiqu sempande. Lapho isitshalo sitshekile, ama-statoliths awela odongeni olusha lweseli elingezansi. Ngemva kwamahora ambalwa, ihlumela noma impande izobonisa ukukhula ohlangothini olusha oluqondile.

 Indlela elawula i-gravitropism iyaqondakala kahle. Lapho ama-amyloplast ehlala phansi kwamaseli azwa amandla adonsela phansi empandeni noma ehlumeni, athinta ngokomzimba i-endoplasmic reticulum (ER), okubangela ukukhishwa kwama-ion e-calcium ngaphakathi kwe-ER. Lokhu kukhombisa i-calcium emaselini kubangela ukuthuthwa kwe-hormone yesitshalo i-IAA phansi kweseli. Ezimpandeni, ukuhlushwa okuphezulu kwe-IAA kuvimbela ukunwebeka kwamaseli. Umphumela wehlisa ukukhula ohlangothini olungezansi lwempande, kuyilapho amaseli ekhula ngokujwayelekile ohlangothini oluphezulu. I-IAA inomphumela ophambene emahlumeni, lapho ukuhlushwa okuphezulu ohlangothini olungezansi lwehlumela kukhuthaza ukwanda kwamaseli, okubangela ukuba ihlumela likhule. Ngemva kokuba ihlumela noma impande ziqale ukukhula ziqonde phezulu, ama-amyloplast abuyela endaweni yawo evamile. Ezinye izinkolelo-mbono—ezihilela lonke iseli emphumeleni we-gravitropism—ziye zahlongozwa ukuchaza ukuthi kungani ezinye izinguquko ezingenawo ama-amyloplast zingase zibonise impendulo ebuthakathaka ye-gravitropic.
question1: Kuyini i-gravitropism?
answer1: Impendulo yokukhula kwezitshalo kumandla adonsela phansi
question2: Kuyini i-gravitropism engemihle?
answer2: Ukukhula kwamahlumela kuya phezulu, kude namandla adonsela phansi
question3: Yiziphi i-organelles ezikhethekile ezisebenza njengezinzwa zamandla adonsela phansi ezitshalweni?
question4: Atholakalaphi ama-amyloplast azwa amandla adonsela phansi?
answer4: Emahlumela nasemaseli akhethekile e-root cap
question5: Kwenzekani lapho ama-amyloplast ehlala phansi kwamaseli azwa amandla adonsela phansi?
answer5: Zibangela ukukhishwa kwama-ion e-calcium avela ku-endoplasmic reticulum
question6: Ukuhlushwa okuphezulu kwe-indole acetic acid (IAA) kuthinta kanjani amaseli ezimpande?
answer6: Ivimbela ukunwebeka kwamaseli
distractor6b: Kubangela ukuba amaseli ezimpande ahlukane ngokushesha
question7: Ukuhlushwa okuphezulu kwe-indole acetic acid (IAA) kuthinta kanjani amaseli okudubula?
answer7: Kuvuselela ukunwebeka kwamaseli, okwenza ihlumela likhule liye phezulu
distractor7b: Kubangela ukuthi ihlumela likhule liye phansi
question8: Kungani ezinye izakhi zofuzo ezingenazo i-amyloplast zingase zibonise impendulo ebuthakathaka ye-gravitropic?
answer8: Ezinye izindlela ngaphandle kwama-amyloplast nazo zingase zibe negalelo ekuboneni amandla adonsela phansi
distractor8a: Ukuzwa kwamandla adonsela phansi kuncike ngokuphelele kuma-chloroplast
distractor8b: Izimpande azidingi ukuzwa amandla adonsela phansi
distractor8c: Izitshalo zisabela ekukhanyeni kuphela, hhayi ekudonseleni phansi

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zokukhula
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Growth Responses
chapterContent:
Impendulo yesitshalo ezinzwa ezishukumisweni zangaphandle incike ezithunyweni zamakhemikhali (ama-hormone). Ama-hormone ezitshalo athinta zonke izici zokuphila kwezitshalo, kusukela ekuqhakazeni kuya ekubekeni kwezithelo nasekuvuthweni, kanye nasekuvuthweni kweqabunga. Cishe wonke amaseli esitshalweni angakhiqiza ama-hormone ezitshalo. Angasebenza esitokisini sawo esivela kuso noma athuthelwe kwezinye izingxenye zomzimba wesitshalo, ngezimpendulo eziningi zezitshalo ezibandakanya ukusebenzisana okusebenzisana noma okuphikisayo kwama-hormone amabili noma ngaphezulu. Ngokuphambene nalokho, ama-hormone ezilwane akhiqizwa ezindlala ezithile futhi athuthelwe endaweni ekude ukuze enze isenzo, futhi asebenza wodwa.

 Ama-hormone ezitshalo ayiqembu lezinto zamakhemikhali ezingahlobene ezithinta i-plant morphogenesis. Ama-hormone amahlanu amakhulu ezitshalo achazwa ngokwesiko: ama-auxin (ikakhulukazi i-IAA), ama-cytokinins, ama-gibberellins, i-ethylene, kanye ne-abscisic acid. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izakhamzimba kanye nezimo zemvelo zingachazwa njengezici zokukhula
question1: Yini izitshalo eziyisebenzisayo ngokuyinhloko ukuhlanganisa izimpendulo zazo ezintweni ezithinta imvelo?
answer1: Izithunywa zamakhemikhali ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-hormone ezitshalo
question2: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ama-hormone ezitshalo?
answer2: Zingakhiqizwa amaseli amaningi ezitshalo futhi zingasebenza endaweni noma zithuthelwe kwezinye izingxenye zesitshalo.
question3: Ama-hormone ezitshalo avame ukusebenzisana kanjani ukulawula izimpendulo zezitshalo?
answer3: Ngokuvamile basebenza ngokubambisana noma ngokuphikisa namanye ama-hormone
distractor3b: I-hormone eyodwa kuphela engasebenza ngesikhathi esisodwa
question4: Ama-hormone ezitshalo ahluke kanjani kuma-hormone ezilwane?
answer4: Ama-hormone ezitshalo akhiqizwa amaseli amaningi futhi avame ukusebenza ndawonye, kanti ama-hormone ezilwane akhiqizwa ezindlala ezithile futhi ngokuvamile asebenza ngawodwana.
distractor4a: Ama-hormone ezitshalo angamaprotheni, kanti ama-hormone ezilwane wonke angama-lipid
distractor4b: Ama-hormone ezitshalo adinga imizwa ukuze afinyelele imigomo yawo
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyi-hormone yesitshalo enkulu?
answer5: I-Auxin
question6: Yiliphi i-hormone yesitshalo emelelwa yisifinyezo se-IAA?
answer6: I-Auxin
question7: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungeyona enye yama-hormone amahlanu amakhulu ezitshalo achazwa ngokwesiko?
answer7: I-insulini
question8: Ama-hormone ezitshalo athonya ziphi izici zokuphila kwezitshalo?
answer8: Izinqubo ezihlanganisa ukuqhakaza, ukuthuthuka kwezithelo, i-phototropism, kanye nokuwa kwamaqabunga

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zokukhula | Ama-Auxins
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Growth Responses | Auxins
chapterContent:
Igama elithi auxin lisuselwa egameni lesiGreki elithi auxein, elisho ukukhula. Ama-Auxin angama-hormone ayinhloko abangela ukwanda kwamaseli ku-phototropism kanye ne-gravitropism. Aphinde alawule ukuhlukaniswa kwe-meristem ibe yizicubu zemithambo yegazi, futhi akhuthaze ukukhula nokuhlelwa kwamaqabunga. Ngenkathi ama-auxin amaningi okwenziwa esetshenziswa njengemithi yokubulala ukhula, i-IAA iyona kuphela i-auxin eyenzeka ngokwemvelo ekhombisa umsebenzi womzimba. Ukubusa kwe-apical—ukuvimbela ukwakheka kwamahlumela aseceleni—kubangelwa ama-auxin akhiqizwa ku-apical meristem. Ukuqhakaza, ukubeka izithelo nokuvuthwa, kanye nokuvimbela ukuqunjelwa (ukuwa kwamaqabunga) ezinye izimpendulo zezitshalo ngaphansi kokulawulwa okuqondile noma okungaqondile kwama-auxin. Ama-Auxin asebenza futhi njengendlela yokudlulisela imiphumela yokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kanye nezimpendulo ezibomvu/ezibomvu kakhulu.

 Ukusetshenziswa kwe-auxin kwezentengiselwano kusakazeke kakhulu ezindaweni zokukhulisa izitshalo kanye nokukhiqizwa kwezitshalo. I-IAA isetshenziswa njenge-hormone yezimpande ukukhuthaza ukukhula kwezimpande ezikhula ngokushesha ezinqunyiwe kanye namaqabunga ahlukanisiwe. Ukusebenzisa ama-auxin okwenziwa ezitshalweni zikatamatisi ezindaweni zokugcina izitshalo kukhuthaza ukukhula kwezithelo okuvamile. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-auxin ngaphandle kukhuthaza ukuvumelanisa ukusethwa kwezithelo nokuwa kwazo ukuze kuhlanganiswe isikhathi sokuvuna. Izithelo ezifana nokhukhamba olungenambewu zingakhuthazwa ukuthi zimise izithelo ngokwelapha izimbali zezitshalo ezingavundiswanga nge-auxins

answer6: Ukukhuthaza ukwakheka kwezimpande ezizithelayo

question8: Ukhukhamba olungenambewu lungenziwa kanjani ukuthi lukhule?
answer8: Ngokwelapha izimbali ezingavundiswanga nge-auxins

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zokukhula | Ama-Cytokinins
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Growth Responses | Cytokinins
chapterContent: Umphumela wama-cytokinins wabikwa okokuqala lapho kutholakala ukuthi ukufaka i-endosperm ewuketshezi yamakhukhunathi kuma-embryo ezitshalo ezisakhula emasikweni kwavuselela ukukhula kwawo. Isici sokukhula esishukumisayo satholakala ukuthi yi-cytokinin, i-hormone ekhuthaza i-cytokinesis (ukuhlukaniswa kwamaseli). Cishe ama-cytokinins angu-200 avela ngokwemvelo noma okwenziwa ayaziwa kuze kube manje. Ama-cytokinins atholakala kakhulu ezicutshini ezikhulayo, njengezimpande, ama-embryo, nezithelo, lapho kwenzeka khona ukuhlukana kwamaseli. Ama-Cytokinins ayaziwa ukuthi abambezela ukuguga kwezicubu zamaqabunga, akhuthaze i-mitosis, futhi akhuthaze ukuhlukaniswa kwe-meristem emahlumela nasezimpandeni. Imiphumela eminingi ekuthuthukisweni kwezitshalo ingaphansi kwethonya lama-cytokinins, kungaba ngokuhlangana ne-auxin noma enye i-hormone. Isibonelo, ukubusa kwe-apical kubonakala sengathi kubangelwa ukulinganisela phakathi kwama-auxin avimbela amahlumela aseceleni, nama-cytokinins akhuthaza ukukhula okunamandla.

answer8: Ukukhula okukhulu ngokwandisa amagatsha aseceleni

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zokukhula | Ama-Gibberellins
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Growth Responses | Gibberellins
chapterContent:
Ama-Gibberellin (ama-GA) ayiqembu lama-hormone ezitshalo ahlobene eduze angaba ngu-125 akhuthaza ukunwebeka kwehlumela, ukuhluma kwembewu, kanye nokuvuthwa kwezithelo nezimbali. Ama-GA akhiqizwa empandeni nasesiqwini se-meristems, emaqabungeni amancane, kanye nama-embryo embewu. Ezindaweni zasemadolobheni, ama-GA aphikisanayo ngezinye izikhathi asetshenziswa ezihlahleni ngaphansi kwezintambo zikagesi ukulawula ukukhula nokunciphisa imvamisa yokuthena.

 Ama-GA aphula ukungakwazi ukukhula (isimo sokukhula okuvinjelwe kanye nokukhula) embewini yezitshalo ezidinga ukuchayeka emakhazeni noma ekukhanyeni ukuze zikhule. Eminye imiphumela yama-GA ifaka phakathi ukuvezwa kobulili, ukukhula kwezithelo ezingenambewu, kanye nokubambezeleka kokuguga emaqabunga nasezithelo. Amagilebhisi angenambewu atholakala ngezindlela ezijwayelekile zokuzalanisa futhi aqukethe imbewu engabonakali ehluleka ukukhula. Ngenxa yokuthi ama-GA akhiqizwa yimbewu, futhi ngenxa yokuthi ukukhula kwezithelo kanye nokukhula kwesiqu kungaphansi kokulawulwa kwe-GA, lezi zinhlobo zamagilebhisi ngokuvamile zikhiqiza izithelo ezincane ngamaqoqo amancane. Amagilebhisi avuthiwe avame ukuphathwa nge-GA ukuze kukhuthazwe usayizi wezithelo ezinkulu, kanye nezinqwaba ezikhululekile (iziqu ezinde), okunciphisa ukutheleleka kwesikhunta (Isithombe 23.40)
question1: Uyini umsebenzi oyinhloko wama-gibberellin (ama-GA)?
answer1: Zikhuthaza ukunwebeka kwamahlumela, ukuhluma kwembewu, kanye nokuvuthwa kwezithelo nezimbali
distractor1a: Zivimbela ukukhula kwesiqu futhi zikhuthaza ukuqunjelwa kwamaqabunga
question2: Kuphi lapho ama-gibberellin akhiqizwa khona ngokuyinhloko?
answer2: Ezimpandeni nasesiqwini, ama-meristems asezingeni eliphezulu, amaqabunga amancane, kanye nama-embryo embewu
question3: Kungani ngezinye izikhathi ama-gibberellin antagonists esetshenziswa ezihlahleni ezikhula ngaphansi kwezintambo zikagesi?
answer3: Ukunciphisa ukukhula kwehlumela nokunciphisa isidingo sokusika
question4: Ama-gibberellin ayithinta kanjani i-seed dormancy?
answer4: Ziphula ukungahlali kahle kwembewu futhi zikhuthaza ukuhluma kwayo
question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuwumphumela we-gibberellins?
answer5: Zingakhuthaza ukukhula kwezithelo ezingenambewu
question6: Kungani amagilebhisi angenambewu atshalwa ngokuhweba ephathwa nge-gibberellins?
answer6: Ukukhiqiza amagilebhisi amakhulu kanye namaqoqo axegayo
question7: Amaqoqo amagilebhisi axegayo azuzisa kanjani ukukhiqizwa kwamagilebhisi?
answer7: Zinciphisa ukwanda kokutheleleka kwesikhunta
question8: Ngaphandle kokukhuthaza ukuhluma nokwelulwa kwehlumela, ama-gibberellin nawo ayasiza ekubambezelekeni:
answer8: Ukuguga kwamaqabunga nezithelo

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zokukhula | I-Abscisic Acid
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Growth Responses | Abscisic Acid
chapterContent:
I-hormone yesitshalo i-abscisic acid (ABA) yaqala ukutholwa njenge-ejenti ebangela ukuqunjelwa noma ukuwa kwama-cotton bolls. Kodwa-ke, izifundo zakamuva zibonisa ukuthi i-ABA idlala indima encane kuphela enqubweni yokuqunjelwa. I-ABA iqoqana njengempendulo ezimweni zemvelo ezicindezelayo, njengokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, amazinga okushisa abandayo, noma ubude bezinsuku obufushane. Umsebenzi wayo ulwa nemiphumela eminingi ekhuthaza ukukhula kwama-GA nama-auxin. I-ABA ivimbela ukunwebeka kwesiqu futhi ibangele ukuqunjelwa emahlumeni aseceleni.

 I-ABA ibangela ukuqunjelwa embewini ngokuvimbela ukuhluma nokukhuthaza ukwakheka kwamaprotheni okugcina. Izitshalo ezivumelaniswe nezimo zezulu ezifudumele zidinga isikhathi eside sokushisa okubandayo ngaphambi kokuba imbewu ihlume. Le ndlela ivikela izitshalo ezincane ekuhlumeni kusenesikhathi ngesikhathi sezulu esifudumele esingajwayelekile ebusika. Njengoba i-hormone iphuka kancane kancane ebusika, imbewu ikhishwa ekuquthweni futhi ihlume lapho izimo zivuma entwasahlobo. Omunye umphumela we-ABA ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwamahlumela asebusika; iqondisa ukuguqulwa kwe-apical meristem ibe yihlumela elingenalutho. Umswakama ophansi wenhlabathi ubangela ukwanda kwe-ABA, okubangela ukuthi i-stomata ivaleke, okunciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi eziqubeni zasebusika.

answer1: Ngesikhathi sezimo ezicindezelayo njengokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, amazinga okushisa abandayo, noma ubude bemini obufushane

answer8: Kubangela ukuthi i-stomata ivaleke, kunciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zokukhula | I-Ethylene
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Growth Responses | Ethylene
chapterContent:
I-Ethylene ihlotshaniswa nokuvuthwa kwezithelo, ukubuna kwezimbali, kanye nokuwa kwamaqabunga. I-Ethylene ayijwayelekile ngoba iyigesi eguquguqukayo (C2H4). Emakhulwini eminyaka edlule, lapho kufakwa izibani zemigwaqo yegesi emigwaqweni yedolobha, izihlahla ezazikhula eduze kwezigxobo zezibani zakha iziqu ezisontekile, ezijiyile futhi zalahla amaqabunga azo ngaphambi kwesikhathi esilindelwe. Le miphumela yabangelwa ukuwohloka kwe-ethylene okuvela ezibani.

 Izicubu ezigugayo (ikakhulukazi amaqabunga aqothulayo) kanye namaqhubu eziqu kukhiqiza i-ethylene. Nokho, umphumela owaziwa kakhulu we-hormone ukukhuthaza ukuvuthwa kwezithelo. I-Ethylene ikhuthaza ukuguqulwa kwesitashi nama-asidi kube ushukela. Abanye abantu bagcina izithelo ezingavuthiwe, njenge-avocado, esikhwameni sephepha esivaliwe ukuze kusheshiswe ukuvuthwa; igesi ekhishwa yisithelo sokuqala ukuvuthwa izosheshisa ukuvuthwa kwesithelo esisele. I-Ethylene iphinda ibangele ukubola kwamaqabunga nezithelo, ukubuna kwezimbali nokuwa, futhi ikhuthaza ukuhluma kwezinye okusanhlamvu kanye nokuhluma kwama-bulb namazambane.

 I-Ethylene isetshenziswa kabanzi kwezolimo. Abalimi bezithelo bezentengiselwano balawula isikhathi sokuvuthwa kwezithelo ngokusebenzisa igesi. Abalimi bezitshalo bavimbela ukuwa kwamaqabunga ezitshalweni zokuhlobisa ngokususa i-ethylene ezindlini zokugcina izitshalo besebenzisa amafeni kanye nomoya wokungenisa umoya.

answer8: Ngokususa i-ethylene ezindlini zokugcina izithombo kusetshenziswa amafeni kanye nokungenisa umoya

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nokusebenza Kwazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zokukhula | Ama-hormone Angewona Awendabuko
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Growth Responses | Nontraditional Hormones
chapterContent:
Ucwaningo lwamuva nje luthole inani le-com amakhilogremu elithinta nokukhula kwezitshalo. Imisebenzi yazo ayiqondwa kahle kunemiphumela yama-hormone amakhulu achazwe kuze kube manje.

 Ama-Jasmonate adlala indima enkulu ekuphenduleni kokuzivikela ezitshalweni. Amazinga awo ayanda lapho isitshalo silinyazwa yisilwane esidla ezinye izilwane, okuholela ekwandeni kwama-metabolites anobuthi. Anegalelo ekukhiqizweni kwe-volatile com amakhilogremu eheha izitha zemvelo zezilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane. Isibonelo, ukuhlafuna izitshalo zikatamatisi ngamacimbi kuholela ekwandeni kwamazinga e-jasmonic acid, okubangela ukukhishwa kwe-volatile com amakhilogremu eheha izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane.

 Ama-Oligosaccharins nawo adlala indima ekuvikeleni izitshalo ekuthelelekeni ngamagciwane kanye nesikhunta. Asebenza endaweni lapho ukulimala kwenzeka khona, futhi angathuthwa aye kwezinye izicubu. Ama-Strigolactones akhuthaza ukuhluma kwembewu kwezinye izinhlobo futhi avimbele ukuthuthukiswa kwe-apical lateral lapho kungekho ama-auxin. Ama-Strigolactones nawo adlala indima ekusungulweni kwe-mycorrhizae, ukuhlangana okuhlangene kwezimpande zezitshalo kanye nesikhunta. Ama-Brassinosteroids abalulekile ezinqubweni eziningi zokuthuthukiswa kanye nezomzimba. Izimpawu phakathi kwala ma-com amakhilogremu namanye ama-hormone, ikakhulukazi i-auxin kanye ne-GA, zandisa umphumela wawo womzimba. Ukubusa kwe-apical, ukuhluma kwembewu, i-gravitropism, kanye nokumelana nokuqandisa konke kuthonywa kahle ama-hormone. Ukukhula kwezimpande kanye nokuwa kwezithelo kuvinjelwa ama-steroids

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zezitshalo Emoyeni Nasekuthintweni
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Plant Responses to Wind and Touch
chapterContent:
Ukuhluma kwesitshalo se-pea kuzungeza i-trellis, kuyilapho isihlahla sikhula nge-engela ngenxa yemimoya enamandla ekhona. Lezi yizibonelo zendlela izitshalo ezisabela ngayo ekuthinteni noma emoyeni.

 Ukunyakaza kwesitshalo esicindezelwa njalo kubizwa ngokuthi i-thigmotropism, kusukela kumagama esiGreki athi thigma asho ukuthinta,” kanye ne-tropism esho ukuthinta.” Ama-Tendril ayisibonelo esisodwa salokhu. Isifunda se-meristematic sama-tendril sizwela kakhulu ekuthinteni; ukuthinta okulula kuzovusa impendulo esheshayo yokugoqa. Amaseli athintana nobuso obusekelayo ayancipha, kanti amaseli ohlangothini oluphambene nokusekela ayanda (Isithombe 23.14(a)). Ukusetshenziswa kwe-jasmonic acid kwanele ukuqala ukugoqa kwama-tendril ngaphandle kwesikhuthazo somshini.

 Impendulo ye-thigmonastic iyimpendulo yokuthinta engaphandle kwesiqondiso sesikhuthazo Umfanekiso 23.24. Ku-Venus flytrap, amaqabunga amabili aguquliwe ahlanganiswe ku-hinge futhi afakwe ama-tines amancane afana nefoloko emaphethelweni angaphandle. Izinwele ezincane zitholakala ngaphakathi kogibe. Uma isinambuzane sithinta lezi zinwele ezibangela lesi simila, sithinta ezimbili noma ngaphezulu zazo ngokulandelana, amaqabunga avala ngokushesha, abambe isisulu. Izindlala ebusweni beqabunga zikhipha ama-enzyme agaya kancane kancane isinambuzane. Izakhamzimba ezikhishwe zimuncwa amaqabunga, aphinde avuleke ukuze kudliwe ukudla okulandelayo.

 I-Thigmomorphogenesis ushintsho olukhula kancane esimweni sesitshalo esibhekene nokucindezeleka okuqhubekayo komshini. Lapho izihlahla zigoba emoyeni, isibonelo, ukukhula kuvame ukuvinjelwa futhi isiqu siyaqina. Ukuqinisa izicubu, ikakhulukazi i-xylem, kukhiqizwa ukuze kwengezwe ukuqina ukuze kumelwane namandla omoya. Abacwaningi bacabanga ukuthi ukucindezeleka komshini kubangela ukukhula nokwehluka ukuze kuqiniswe izicubu. I-Ethylene ne-jasmonate cishe zihilelekile ku-thigmomorphogenesis.

 Isitshalo se-mimosa saziwa nangokuthi isitshalo esibucayi, ngoba amaqabunga aso azwela ukuthintwa futhi azogoqa ngaphakathi futhi awe. Amaqabunga asesimweni sawo esijwayelekile aboniswe ngakwesobunxele. Bheka Umfanekiso 23.41

chapterName: 6. Isakhiwo Sezitshalo Nomsebenzi Wazo | 23. Ifomu Lezitshalo Ne-Physiology | 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo | Izimpendulo Zokuzivikela Ezilwa Nezimila Ezidla Uhlaza Nezifo Ezibangelwa Yizifo
chapterNameEnglish: 6. Plant Structure and Function | 23. Plant Form and Physiology | 23.6 Plant Sensory Systems and Responses | Defense Responses against Herbivores and Pathogens
chapterContent:
Izitshalo zibhekene nezinhlobo ezimbili zezitha: izilwane ezidla uhlaza kanye nezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane. Izilwane ezidla uhlaza ezinkulu nezincane zisebenzisa izitshalo njengokudla, futhi ziyazihlafuna ngenkuthalo. Izifo ezibangelwa amagciwane ziyizinto ezibangela izifo. Lawa ma-microorganism athelelanayo, njengesikhunta, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-nematode, aphila esitshalweni futhi alimaze izicubu zaso. Izitshalo ziye zakha amasu ahlukahlukene okudambisa noma ukubulala abahlaseli.

 Umzila wokuqala wokuzivikela ezitshalweni uwumgoqo oqinile futhi ongenakungenwa. Igxolo kanye ne-cuticle ene-wax kungavikela ezidla ezinye izilwane. Ezinye izindlela zokulwa nezilwane ezidla uhlaza zifaka ameva, angamagatsha aguquliwe, kanye namathambo, angamaqabunga aguquliwe. Zidambisa izilwane ngokubangela umonakalo ongokwenyama kanye nokudala ukuqubuka kanye nokusabela kokungezwani komzimba. Ukuvikelwa kwangaphandle kwesitshalo kungenziwa kabi ngomonakalo wemishini, okungase kuhlinzeke indawo yokungena kwezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane. Uma umzila wokuqala wokuzivikela uphulwa, isitshalo kumele sisebenzise isethi ehlukile yezindlela zokuzivikela, njengobuthi nama-enzyme.

 Ama-metabolite esibili angama-com amakhilogremu angatholakali ngqo ku-photosynthesis futhi awadingeki ekuphefumuleni noma ekukhuleni nasekuthuthukisweni kwezitshalo. Ama-metabolite amaningi anobuthi, futhi angaba yingozi ngisho nasezilwaneni eziwadlayo. Amanye ama-metabolite angama-alkaloid, aqeda amandla ezidla ezinye ngephunga elibi (njengamafutha aguquguqukayo e-mint ne-sage) noma ukunambitheka okuxoshayo (njengokubaba kwe-quinine). Amanye ama-alkaloid athinta izilwane ezidla uhlaza ngokubangela ukukhuthazwa ngokweqile (i-caffeine iyisibonelo esisodwa) noma ukudinwa okuhambisana nama-opioid. Amanye ama-com amakhilogremu aba nobuthi ngemva kokugwinywa; isibonelo, i-glycol cyanide empandeni ye-cassava ikhipha i-cyanide kuphela lapho igwinywa yi-herbivore.

 Ukulimala ngomshini kanye nokuhlasela kwezilwane ezidla ezinye kusebenzisa izindlela zokuzivikela kanye nokuvikela kokubili ezicutshini ezonakele nasezindaweni ezikude nendawo yokulimala. Ezinye izindlela zokuzivikela zenzeka ngemizuzu embalwa: ezinye zingakapheli amahora amaningana. Amaseli athelelekile nawazungezile angafa, ngaleyo ndlela avimbele ukusabalala kokutheleleka.

 Ukubonisana ibanga elide kuveza impendulo ehlelekile ehlose ukuvimbela izilwane ezidla ezinye. Njengoba izicubu zonakele, ama-jasmonate angakhuthaza ukwakheka kwama-com amakhilogremu anobuthi ezilwani. Ama-jasmonate aphinde akhuthaze ukwakheka kwama-com amakhilogremu adonsela ama-parasitoid, okuyizinambuzane ezichitha izigaba zazo zokukhula kwesinye isinambuzane, futhi ekugcineni zibulale umnikazi wazo. Lesi sitshalo singavuselela ukubola kwezicubu ezilimele uma sonakele ngendlela engenakulungiseka.

chapterContent:
23.1 Umzimba Wesitshalo
Isitshalo esinemithambo yegazi sakhiwe yizinhlelo ezimbili zezitho: uhlelo lokudubula kanye nohlelo lwempande. Uhlelo lokudubula luhlanganisa izingxenye zezitshalo ezingenhla komhlaba (iziqu namaqabunga) kanye nezingxenye zokuzala (izimbali nezithelo). Uhlelo lwempande lusekela isitshalo futhi luvame ukuba ngaphansi komhlaba. Isitshalo sakhiwe yizinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zezicubu: izicubu ze-meristematic kanye nezicubu ezihlala njalo. Izicubu ze-meristematic zakhiwa amaseli ahlukanisa ngenkuthalo atholakala eziqongweni zezimpande kanye nezicubu. Njengoba ukukhula kwenzeka, izicubu ze-meristematic ziyahluka zibe izicubu ezihlala njalo, ezihlukaniswa njengezilula noma eziyinkimbinkimbi. Izicubu ezilula zakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezifanayo zamaseli; izibonelo zifaka phakathi izicubu zesikhumba kanye nezicubu ezihlala phansi. Izicubu zesikhumba zihlinzeka ngesembozo sangaphandle sesitshalo. Izicubu ezihlala phansi zinomthwalo we-photosynthesis; futhi zisekela izicubu zemithambo yegazi futhi zingagcina amanzi noshukela. Izicubu eziyinkimbinkimbi zakhiwe ngezinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli. Izicubu zemithambo yegazi, isibonelo, zakhiwe ngamaseli e-xylem kanye ne-phloem.

 23.2 Iziqu
Isiqu sesitshalo sithwala amaqabunga, izimbali, nezithelo. Iziqu zibonakala ngokuba khona kwama-node (amaphuzu okunamathela kwamaqabunga noma amagatsha) kanye nama-internode (izifunda eziphakathi kwama-node).

 Izitho zezitshalo zakhiwe izicubu ezilula neziyinkimbinkimbi. Isiqu sinezinhlelo ezintathu zezicubu: isikhumba, imithambo yegazi, kanye nezicubu zomhlabathi. Izicubu zesikhumba ziyisimbozo sangaphandle sesitshalo. Siqukethe amangqamuzana e-epidermal, i-stomata, amangqamuzana okuvikela, kanye nama-trichomes. Izicubu zemithambo yegazi zakhiwe izicubu ze-xylem kanye ne-phloem futhi ziqhuba amanzi, amaminerali, kanye nemikhiqizo ye-photosynthetic. Izicubu zomhlabathi zinomthwalo we-photosynthesis kanye nokusekela futhi zakhiwe amaseli e-parenchyma, i-collenchyma, kanye ne-sclerenchyma.

 Ukukhula okuyinhloko kwenzeka eziqongweni zezimpande namahlumela, okubangela ukwanda kobude. Izitshalo ezinezinkuni nazo zingabonisa ukukhula kwesibili, noma ukwanda kobukhulu. Ezitshalweni ezinezinkuni, ikakhulukazi izihlahla, amasongo onyaka angakheka njengoba ukukhula kwehla ekupheleni kwesizini ngayinye. Ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo zineziqu eziguquliwe ezisiza ukugcina ukudla, ukusabalalisa izitshalo ezintsha, noma ukudikibalisa izilwane ezidla ezinye. Ama-Rhizome, ama-corms, ama-stolons, ama-runners, ama-tubers, ama-bulbs, ama-tendril, kanye nameva kuyizibonelo zeziqu eziguquliwe.

 23.3 Izimpande
Izimpande zisiza ekuqiniseni isitshalo, zimunce amanzi namaminerali, futhi zisebenza njengezindawo zokugcina ukudla. Izimpande eziqinile kanye nezimpande ezinemicu yizinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zezinhlelo zezimpande. Ohlelweni lwempande eqondile, impande eyinhloko ikhula iqonde phansi ngezimpande ezimbalwa eziseceleni. Izinhlelo zezimpande ezinemicu zivela phansi kwesiqu, lapho iqoqo lezimpande lakha inethiwekhi exineneyo engajulile kunempande eqondile. Isihloko sempande ekhulayo sivikelwe yisivalo sempande. Isihloko sempande sinezindawo ezintathu eziyinhloko: indawo yokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli (amangqamuzana ahlukana ngenkuthalo), indawo yokwelulwa (amangqamuzana ayanda ngobude), kanye nendawo yokuvuthwa (amangqamuzana ahluka ukuze akhe izinhlobo ezahlukene zamaseli). Izicubu zemithambo yezimpande ziqhuba amanzi, amaminerali, noshukela. Kwezinye izindawo zokuhlala, izimpande zezitshalo ezithile zingaguqulwa ukuze zakhe izimpande zasemoyeni noma izimpande ze-epiphytic.

 23.4 Amaqabunga
Amaqabunga ayindawo eyinhloko ye-photosynthesis. Iqabunga elivamile liqukethe i-lamina (ingxenye ebanzi yeqabunga, ebizwa nangokuthi i-blade) kanye ne-petiole (isiqu esinamathisela iqabunga esiqwini). Ukuhlelwa kwamaqabunga esiqwini, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-phyllotaxy, kwenza kube lula kakhulu ukuchayeka elangeni. Uhlobo ngalunye lwesitshalo lunokuhlelwa kweqabunga okuhlukile kanye nesimo salo. Iphethini yokuhlelwa kweqabunga ingaba ngokushintshana, okuphambene, noma okujikelezayo, kuyilapho isimo seqabunga singaba lula noma sihlanganiswe. Izicubu zeqabunga zakhiwa yi-epidermis, eyakha ungqimba lweseli olungaphandle, kanye nezicubu ze-mesophyll kanye nemithambo yegazi, ezakha ingxenye engaphakathi yeqabunga. Kwezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo, isimo seqabunga siyashintshwa ukuze sakhe izakhiwo ezifana nama-tendril, izimpande, izikali zamahlumela, kanye nezinaliti.

 23.5 Ukuthuthwa Kwamanzi Nezingxube Ezitshalweni
Amandla amanzi (Ψ) isilinganiso somehluko emandleni angaba khona phakathi kwesampula yamanzi namanzi ahlanzekile. Amandla amanzi ezixazululweni zezitshalo athonywa ukuhlushwa kwe-solute, ingcindezi, amandla adonsela phansi, kanye namandla e-matric. Amandla amanzi kanye nokuphefumulela kuthonya indlela amanzi athuthwa ngayo nge-xylem ezitshalweni. Lezi zinqubo zilawulwa ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwesisu. Ama-photosynthates (ikakhulukazi i-sucrose) ahamba esuka emithonjeni aye ezinkingeni nge-phloem yesitshalo. I-Sucrose ifakwa ngenkuthalo ezintweni ze-sieve-tube ze-phloem. Ukuhlushwa kwe-solute okwandisiwe kubangela ukuthi amanzi ahambe nge-osmosis esuka ku-xylem aye kwi-phloem. Ingcindezi enhle ekhiqizwayo isunduza amanzi futhi incibilikise phansi kwe-gradient yengcindezi. I-sucrose ithululwa esinkini, bese amanzi abuyela emithanjeni ye-xylem.

 23.6 Izinhlelo Nezimpendulo Zezinzwa Zezitshalo
Izitshalo zisabela ekukhanyeni ngokushintsha kwesimo kanye nomsebenzi. Ukushiswa ngokukhanya okubomvu kuguqula i-photoreceptor phytochrome ibe yifomu layo elibomvu kakhulu lokumunca ukukhanya—i-Pfr. Lolu hlobo lulawula ukuhluma nokuqhakaza kwezimbali ngokuphendula ubude bosuku, kanye nokuqala i-photosynthesis ezitshalweni ezingasebenzi noma lezo ezisanda kuvela enhlabathini. Ama-receptor okukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ama-cryptochrome, nama-phototropin abangela i-phototropism. Ama-Amyloplast, aqukethe ama-granules esitashi esindayo, azwa amandla adonsela phansi. Amahlumela abonisa i-gravitropism engemihle, kanti izimpande zibonisa i-gravitropism enhle. Ama-hormone ezitshalo—avela ngokwemvelo amakhilogremu enziwa ngamanani amancane—angasebenza kokubili kumaseli awakhiqizayo nasezicutshini nasezithweni ezikude. Ama-Auxin abangela ukubusa kwe-apical, ukukhula kwezimpande, ukukhula okuqondiswe ekukhanyeni, kanye nezinye izimpendulo eziningi zokukhula. Ama-Cytokinins akhuthaza ukuhlukana kwamaseli futhi alwisane nokubusa kwe-apical emahlumeni. Ama-Gibberellin avimbela ukungasebenzi kahle kwembewu futhi akhuthaze ukukhula kwesiqu. I-Abscisic acid ibangela ukungasebenzi kahle kwembewu namahlumela, futhi ivikela izitshalo ekulahlekelweni kwamanzi ngokweqile ngokukhuthaza ukuvalwa kwesisu. Igesi le-ethylene lisheshisa ukuvuthwa nokuwa kwezithelo. Izitshalo zisabela ekuthinteni ngokunyakaza okusheshayo (i-thigmotropy kanye ne-thigmonasty) kanye nokukhula okuhlukile kancane (i-thigmomorphogenesis). Izitshalo ziye zathuthukisa izindlela zokuzivikela ezilwa nezilwane ezidla ezinye kanye namagciwane. Izithiyo zomzimba ezifana namagxolo kanye nezimpande zivikela izicubu ezithambile. Izitshalo nazo zinezivikelo zamakhemikhali, okuhlanganisa ama-metabolite esibili anobuthi kanye nama-hormone, okudala izindlela zokuzivikela ezengeziwe.

question70: Izitshalo ezinezimpande ezingajulile zonakaliswa kalula ezinye izilwane ezidla uhlaza. Yenza icala elinengqondo lokusekela lesi simangalo

distractor70b: Izimpande ezingajulile azibambeleli isitshalo phansi futhi zingasuswa kalula. Kodwa-ke, uma isitshalo singasekho emhlabathini, izimpande ziyalulama ngokushesha

question72: Ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni kwakho izicubu ze-meristematic, hlola izincazelo ezingezansi. Khetha eyodwa eqhathanisa kangcono izindawo kanye nemisebenzi yezinhlobo ezintathu zezicubu ze-meristematic.

distractor72a: Ama-meristem e-apical atholakala esicongweni seziqu nezimpande akhuthaza ukukhula ngokunwebeka; ama-meristem aseceleni atholakala kuma-node nasezisekelweni zama-blade amaqabunga akhuthaza ukwanda kobude; kanye nama-meristem ahlanganisa ama-calery atholakala ku-vascular kanye ne-cork cambia akhuthaza ukwanda kobubanzi.
distractor72b: Ama-meristem e-apical atholakala kuma-node nasezisekelweni zama-blade amaqabunga akhuthaza ukukhula ngokunwebeka; ama-meristem aseceleni atholakala ku-vascular kanye ne-cork cambia akhuthaza ukwanda kobubanzi; kanti ama-meristem ahlanganisa ama-calary atholakala esicongweni seziqu nezimpande akhuthaza ukwanda kobude.
distractor72c: Ama-meristem e-apical atholakala esicongweni seziqu nezimpande akhuthaza ukukhula ngokunwebeka; ama-meristem aseceleni atholakala ku-vascular kanye ne-cork cambia akhuthaza ukwanda kobude; kanye nama-meristem ahlanganisa i-calendar atholakala kuma-node kanye nasezisekelweni zama-blade amaqabunga akhuthaza ukwanda kobude.

question76: Abafundi babuka amaslayidi amaningana ezingxenye zezicubu ngaphansi kwe-microscope. Bacelwa ukuthi bakhe uhlelo lokhiye lokuhlukanisa amaslayidi njengavela ku-monocot noma kuma-dicot. Yiluphi uhlelo lokhiye okufanele abafundi baluthuthukise?
answer76: Kuma-monocot, ama-vascular bundles ahlakazekile ezicutshini zomhlabathi. Kuma-dicot ama-vascular bundles akha indandatho ehlukile
distractor76a: Kuma-monocot, ama-vascular bundles akha indandatho ehlukile. Kuma-dicot, ama-vascular bundles ahlakazekile ezicutshini zomhlabathi.
distractor76b: Kuma-monocot, izicubu zemithambo yegazi zakha isimo se-X esiyingqayizivele phakathi nendawo. Kuma-dicot, amaseli e-phloem kanye ne-xylem ahlakazekile ku-pith
distractor76c: Ezimpandeni ze-monocot, i-pith ayikho noma incane kakhulu. Kuma-dicot, i-pith inkulu futhi ithuthukiswe kahle
question77: Yimiphi imisebenzi yamaseli e-stomata kanye ne-guard, futhi bekuzokwenzekani esitshalweni uma lawa maseli engasebenzi kahle?
answer77: I-Stomata ivumela amagesi ukuthi angene futhi aphume esitshalweni. Amaseli okuvikela alawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwe-stomata. I-Photosynthesis kanye, ngokuphambene nalokho, ukuphefumulela, ngeke kwenzeke okudingekayo ukuze kugcinwe ukugeleza kwamanzi okuqhubekayo phezulu kusuka ezimpandeni kuya emaqabungeni.
distractor77a: Amaseli okuvikela avumela i-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingene futhi iphume esitshalweni. I-Stomata ilawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwamaseli okuvikela. Uma amaseli engasebenzi, i-photosynthesis kanye nokuphefumulela bekuzophela, okuzophazamisa ukugeleza kwamanzi okuqhubekayo okuvela ezimpandeni kuya emaqabungeni.
distractor77b: I-Stomata ivumela umoya-mpilo ukuthi ungene futhi uphume esitshalweni. Amaseli okuvikela alawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwe-stomata. Uma amaseli engasebenzi, i-photosynthesis ibizoqhubeka kodwa ukugeleza komoya bekuzophela, obekuzophazamisa ukugeleza kwamanzi okuqhubekayo okuvela ezimpandeni kuya emaqabungeni.
distractor77c: Amaseli okuvikela avumela i-carbon dioxide ukuthi ingene futhi iphume esitshalweni. I-Stomata ilawula ukuvulwa nokuvalwa kwamaseli okuvikela. Ukuphefumulela kanye ne-photosynthesis ngeke kwenzeke okudingekayo ukuze kugcinwe ukugeleza kwamanzi okuqhubekayo kusuka ezimpandeni kuya emaqabungeni.

question80: Bheka uMfanekiso 23.47. Ukubopha ibhande kuwukusika amagxolo esihlahla ngendandatho, njengoba kuboniswe esithombeni. Lokhu kuzobulala isihlahla. Lokhu kusitshelani ngezihlahla?

question81: Kuthuthukiswa inkambo yesikhathi ukuze kulandelwe isiphetho sezinqwaba zemithambo yegazi esiqwini sama-dicot. Izingxenye eziseduze nesiqu ziyaqina, zifakwe amabala, futhi zibhekwe ngaphansi kwe-microscope. Qagela ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ezinqwabeni zemithambo yegazi esiqwini se-dicot njengoba isitshalo sikhula, njengoba kwembulwe yimiphumela.
answer81: Izinqwaba zemithambo yegazi ziyahlangana ukuze zakhe amasongo okukhula
distractor81a: Ama-vascular bundles ahlukana abe yi-primary xylem kanye ne-primary phloem.
distractor81b: Ama-vascular bundles ahlukana abe yi-xylem yesibili kanye ne-phloem eyinhloko.
question82: Iyiphi incazelo eqhathanisa kahle uhlelo lwempande empompini nohlelo lwempande olunemicu?
answer82: Uhlelo lwempande oluthambile, njengolwama-karoti, lunempande eyodwa eyinhloko ekhula iye phansi. Uhlelo lwempande oluthambile, njengolukakolweni, lwakha inethiwekhi ebanzi yezimpande eseduze nobuso bomhlabathi. Izinhlelo zezimpande ezithambile zitholakala kuma-monocot kanti izinhlelo zezimpande ezithambile zitholakala kuma-dicot.
distractor82a: Uhlelo lwezimpande olunemicu, njengolwesanqante, lunempande eyodwa eyinhloko ekhula iye phansi. Uhlelo lwezimpande eziqinile, njengolukakolweni, lwakha inethiwekhi ebanzi yezimpande eseduze nobuso bomhlabathi. Izinhlelo zezimpande eziqinile zitholakala kuma-monocot kanti izinhlelo zezimpande eziqinile zitholakala kuma-dicot.
distractor82b: Uhlelo lwempande eqondile, njengolwelayisi, lunempande eyodwa eyinhloko ekhula phansi. Uhlelo lwempande olunemicu, njengolwesanqante, lwakha inethiwekhi ebanzi yezimpande eseduze nobuso bomhlabathi. Izinhlelo zezimpande ezinemicu zitholakala kuma-monocot kanti izinhlelo zezimpande eziqondile zitholakala kuma-dicot.
distractor82c: Uhlelo lwempande ebanzi, njengolwesanqante, lunempande eyodwa eyinhloko ekhula iye phansi. Uhlelo lwempande olunemicu, njengolukakolweni, lwakha inethiwekhi ebanzi yezimpande eseduze nobuso bomhlabathi. Izinhlelo zempande ezibanzi zitholakala kuma-monocot kanti izinhlelo zezimpande ezibanzi zitholakala kuma-dicot.

question85: Sekela isimangalo sokuthi isitshalo sithola izinzuzo ngokugcina ukudla okugciniwe ngaphansi komhlaba ngokuqhathanisa nokukhetha ezincazelweni ezingezansi
answer85: Ukudla okugciniwe ngaphansi komhlaba kufihliwe ezitheni ezingaba khona. Izimo zomhlabathi ezifana nomswakama kanye nokushisa aziguquguquki kakhulu
distractor85a: Izindawo ezigciniwe zokudla zinomsoco kakhulu ngaphansi komhlaba. Izimo zomhlabathi zenza lezi zindawo zokudla zibe ziningi
distractor85b: Izindawo zokugcina ukudla ngaphansi komhlaba zifihliwe ezitheni ezingaba khona. Izimo zenhlabathi zenza lezi zindawo zokugcina ukudla zibe ziningi
distractor85c: Ukudla okugciniwe kunomsoco kakhulu ngaphansi komhlaba. Izimo zenhlabathi ezifana nomswakama kanye nokushisa aziguquguquki kakhulu
question86: Ezinye izitshalo zasehlane zinezimpande ezinde ezifinyelela ku-20-30 amamitha ngaphansi komhlaba. Ezinye zinezimpande ezinemicu ezimboza izindawo ezibanzi. Yenza isibonelo esiqhathanisa ngokunembile izinzuzo zempande ejulile kanye nezinzuzo zesistimu yezimpande ezinemicu ehlane.
answer86: Impande ejulile ingafinyelela ezindaweni ezijulile zomhlabathi ezihlala zimanzi ngemva kwemvula eminingana. Uhlelo olunemicu engajulile lwandisa inani lamanzi angamuncwa ngemva kwemvula encane lapho inhlabathi yoma ngokushesha ehlane.
distractor86a: Impande ejulile ingafinyelela ezindaweni ezijulile zomhlabathi ezihlala zimanzi ngemva kwemvula eminingana. Uhlelo olunemicu engajulile lunikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe kokuqinisa isitshalo ogwadule.
distractor86b: Impande ejulile inikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe kokuqinisa isitshalo ehlane. Uhlelo olunemicu engajulile lwandisa inani lamanzi angamuncwa ngemva kwemvula encane lapho inhlabathi yoma ngokushesha ehlane.
distractor86c: Impande ejulile yandisa inani lamanzi angamuncwa ngemva kwemvula encane lapho inhlabathi yoma ngokushesha ehlane. Uhlelo olunemicu engajulile lungafinyelela kangcono ezindaweni zomhlabathi ezihlala zimanzi ngemva kwemvula eminingana.
question87: Amasampula amaqabunga avela kuma-monocot nama-dicot abekwa etafuleni elebhu bese abafundi baqala ukuhlunga amaqabunga. Thola ukuthi yisiphi isici esingezansi esizohlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele ukusiza abafundi ukuthi babone ukuthi yimaphi amaqabunga angama-monocot nokuthi yimaphi angama-dicot.
answer87: Ama-monocot anamaqabunga ane-venation efanayo kanti amaqabunga e-dicot ane-venation efana ne-reticulate, efana ne-net.
distractor87a: Amaseli e-Bulliform avame ukungabikho kuma-monocot, kuyilapho ekhona engxenyeni engenhla yamaqabunga e-dicot.
distractor87b: Ukulingana kwangaphakathi kubonakala emaqabunga e-monocot, kanti ukulingana kwe-isobilateral kubonakala emaqabunga e-dicot
distractor87c: Ama-monocot anamaqabunga ane-reticulate, i-venation efana ne-net kanye namaqabunga e-dicot ane-venation efanayo
question88: Xoxa ngesimangalo sokuthi iqabunga elihlanganisiwe linikeza isitshalo ithuba lokugwema ukhula ngokuchaza indlela eyenza le nzuzo ibe yiqiniso

question89: Ama-Stomata avame ukutholakala ngamanani aphezulu ebusweni beqabunga noma phansi kweqabunga. Bonisa ukuthi kungani kunjalo ngokuchaza inzuzo yalolu hlelo.

question90: Izitshalo ezahlukene zinokuzivumelanisa nezidingo ezahlukene zemvelo. Hlukanisa phakathi kwezimo ezethulwe ukuze wenze isimangalo sokuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezinamahlamvu ajwayele amazinga okushisa abandayo, nokuthi yiziphi izivumelanisa ezithile ezizisebenzisayo.
answer90: Ama-conifer afana ne-spruce, i-fir, ne-pine anamaqabunga amise okwenaliti ane-stomata etshonile, okusiza ekunciphiseni ukulahleka kwamanzi

question91: Qhathanisa ngokunembile futhi uqhathanise izakhiwo ezimbili zezitshalo, iqabunga kanye nencwajana
answer91: I-petiole yeqabunga inamathela ngqo esiqwini endaweni yokuhluma, kanti i-petiole yeqabunga inamathela esiqwini esikhulu noma endukwini ephakathi, hhayi esiqwini.

question92: Ososayensi abasephrojekthini entsha yokulungisa ixhaphozi likasawoti elonakele baphenya izitshalo eziningana ezingase zethulwe. Isitshalo X sibhekwa njengesingaba khona. question94: I-apoptosis, noma ukufa kweseli okuhleliwe, kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kwe-xylem. I-apoptosis ifaka kanjani isandla ekuthuthukisweni kwe-xylem?

question95: Usombali wanquma ukupenda amaqabunga ezinye izitshalo ze-poinsettia ngopende wegolide ukuze azihlobise. Isitshalo sabuna ngokushesha futhi amaqabunga awela phansi. Yenza isimangalo sokuchaza kahle ukuthi yimuphi umphumela webhayoloji obangele lo monakalo

question96: Inqubo yokugeleza ngobuningi ithutha uketshezi esitshalweni. Yiziphi izinqubo ezimbili eziyinhloko zokugeleza ngobuningi?

question97: Ngesikhathi sesomiso esinzima, inhlabathi iyoma futhi amandla ayo okuwamanzi ayancipha. Izitshalo eziningi zizobuna endaweni enjalo. question98: Isazi sezitshalo siqhathanisa inani le-stomata phakathi kwezitshalo ezimbili. Isitshalo sokuqala, i-eucalyptus, sine-stomata esatshalaliswe ngokulinganayo kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zeqabunga. Isitshalo sesibili sine-stomata yaso eningi ngaphansi kweqabunga. distractor98c: Isitshalo sokuqala sithola ukukhanya kuphela endaweni engenhla, kanti isitshalo sesibili sithola ukukhanya kuphela endaweni engezansi.
question99: ENyakatho Nenkabazwe, abanikazi nabaphathi bezindawo zokukhulisa izitshalo kufanele bahlele amashejuli okukhanyisa isitshalo sosuku olude esizoqhakaza ngoFebhuwari. Yiziphi izikhathi zokukhanyisa nombala okuzosebenza kahle kakhulu?

question100: Kungani izitshalo ezingakwazi ukubona amandla adonsela phansi zibonisa ukukhula okubambekile ngezimpande ezixabene neziqu ezilandelanayo?

question101: Izindawo zokugcina izithelo nemifino zivame ukuba seziqandisini futhi zinomoya omuhle. Kungani lezi zimo ziwusizo?

question102: Isicupho se-Venus fly sinomkhawulo ophansi kakhulu wokuzwela, kodwa singabona umehluko phakathi kokuthintana kokukhanya kwesinambuzane kanye nethonsi lamanzi emvula noma umoya. question104: Kungani ukugwema umthunzi kuyindlela ebalulekile yokusinda ezitshalweni? Ungalindela yini ukuthi imbewu enendawo yokugcina amandla amaningi ibonise impendulo enamandla yokugwema umthunzi njengembewu encane enokulinganiselwa okuncane?

distractor104a: Isithombo esikhula emthunzini wesitshalo esikhulile ngeke sibe nokukhanya okwanele ukukhuthaza ukukhula kwe-meristematic. Imbewu enendawo yokugcina izinto eziningi izokwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhula kuze kube yilapho isithombo sayo sesifinyelele ukukhanya okwanele kwe-photosynthesis

question105: Isitshalo sinamandla okucindezela alinganisiwe angu-Ψp = 0.21MPa kanye namandla okuncibilikisa angu-Ψs =-3.50MPa. Inhlabathi igcwele amanzi ngoba lina. answer105: Amanzi azosuka enhlabathini aye esitshalweni. Inhlabathi eyomile inamandla amancane okumanzi kunenhlabathi emanzi. Ngaphansi kwezimo zesomiso, i-stomata eseduze nokonga amanzi kanye namaqabunga angachitheka uma isomiso siqhubeka.

question106: Bheka Umfanekiso 23.48. Izitshalo zilahlekelwa amanzi ebusweni bazo obungaphezulu komhlaba ngesikhathi sokuphefumula. Iningi lala manzi lilahleka ngenxa ye-stomata. question107: Bheka uMfanekiso 23.34. Hlola umfanekiso wokuhamba kwamanzi namaminerali ezitshalweni. Umswakama uyisici semvelo esithinta izinga lokuphefumula. question108: Bheka uMfanekiso 23.49. Izitshalo zizwa isomiso ngokuncipha kwamandla amanzi emhlabathini. question110: Bheka Umfanekiso 23.50. Imbewu yahluma ebumnyameni emapuletini amathathu. question111: Bheka Umfanekiso 23.50. Imbewu yahluma ebumnyameni emapuletini amathathu. question112: Ngemva kokuba amagatsha ezithombo eziqinile esenqunyiwe, ingxenye yezithombo yambozwa nge-sealant kanti enye ingxenye yashiywa ingathintekile. Izitshalo ezinezithombo ezivaliwe zakhula kangcono ngemva kwamasonto ambalwa. Yini okungenzeka ukuthi iyimbangela?
answer112: Izitshalo ezinezicucu ezingavaliwe zatheleleka ngamagciwane angena ngezicucu.

question113: Bheka Isithombe 23.51. I-Jasmonate ikhiqizwa ezitshalweni njengempendulo yokulimala. Abacwaningi baqhathanisa impendulo yokutheleleka kwezitshalo eziguquliwe ezazingakwazi ukukhiqiza i-jasmonate (Ja-) nempendulo yezitshalo ezivamile (Ja+) ezivela ohlotsheni olufanayo. Amaqabunga afakwa umjovo ngama-spores avela ezikhumbeni ezibangela izifo. Ubukhulu bamanxeba bahlolwa emahoreni angu-48 ngemuva kokusetshenziswa. Izitshalo nazo zatheleleka ngamabhu futhi isisindo sezibungu sanqunywa ngemva kwamahora angu-48. Ngokusho kwemiphumela yokuhlolwa njengoba kuvezwe etafuleni, faka isimangalo sokuthi abacwaningi bangafinyelela kusiphi isiphetho mayelana nokucaciswa kokuvikelwa kwe-jasmonate.
answer113: I-Jasmonate ivikela ekuthelelekeni okuvela ezifweni ezahlukahlukene

distractor113c: I-Jasmonate inikeza ukuzivikela okukhethekile ebusika kanti ukuzivikela akucaci ehlobo.
question114: ENyakatho Nenkabazwe, umlimi wezimbali utshala izihlahla zohlobo olufanayo lwezitshalo ezinezihlahla ngaphansi kwezinhlelo ezimbili zokukhanya ezihlukene amasonto amathathu. distractor114a: Lolu hlobo lwesihlahla aluqhakazi uma usuku lufushane
question115: Bheka uMfanekiso 23.52. I-Heliotropism incazelo yempendulo yezinto eziphilayo ekukhanyeni kwelanga. Abacwaningi benze ucwaningo lwe-heliotropism kuma-sunflower. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-15 zokuvezwa elangeni, izithombo zadluliselwa ebumnyameni obuphelele futhi ukunyakaza kwazo kwaqashelwa. Le grafu idweba ukunyakaza kwezithombo ebumnyameni uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi. Nquma kusukela kugrafu ukuthi yisiphi isiphetho esingatholakala mayelana nokuncika kokukhanya kokunyakaza kwama-sunflower
answer115: Ukunyakaza akudingi ukukhanya uma sekuzinzile futhi kuzogcina kwehle ijubane, okubonisa ukuthi i-molecule yewashi iyonakala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

question116: Bheka Umfanekiso 23.53. Umfundi wakhetha ngokungahleliwe imbewu kagwayi engu-40 yohlobo olufanayo ephaketheni. Wabeka imbewu engu-20 emathawulweni ephepha amanzi esitsheni ngasinye kwezimbili ze-petri. Wasonga isitsha u-A ngokuphelele ngesembozo esingacacile ukuze akhiphe konke ukukhanya. Akazange asisonge isitsha u-B. Wabeka izitsha ezikude ngokulinganayo nomthombo wokukhanya obekwe kumjikelezo wamahora angu-14 okukhanya namahora ayi-10 obumnyama. Zonke ezinye izimo zazifana ezitsheni ezimbili. Wahlola izitsha ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-7, wasusa unomphela isembozo esingacacile esitsheni u-A. Leli thebula libonisa idatha yomfundi. question117: Bheka Umfanekiso 23.54. Amaqembu ezithombo ezingu-20 ezivela ezinhlotsheni ezifanayo zezitshalo aphathwe ngama-gibberellin. Iqembu ngalinye lathola ukuhlushwa okuhlukile kwama-hormone. Izithombo zakhuliswa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo zemvelo. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-15 zokukhula, amabanga e-internode phakathi kweqoqo lokuqala nelesibili lamaqabunga alinganiswa eqenjini ngalinye lezithombo. Kuleli grafu, ibanga eliphakathi kwe-internode leqembu ngalinye lihlelwe ngokuhlushwa kwama-gibberellin iqembu eliwatholile. Chaza imiphumela ukuze wenze isimangalo sokuthi kungani lo mphumela wama-gibberellin kubude be-internode usetshenziswa kwezolimo ukufutha izitshalo zamagilebhisi ezikhiqiza izithelo ezinkulu kakhulu.
answer117: Ukwelula ibanga le-internode nokwamukela izithelo ezinkulu
